speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve recognizes the important role that minority-owned banks play in the financial services market through the services they provide to their communities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: I have chaired the oversight committee on consumer and community affairs at the Board since March and am especially excited to be involved with a number of new and ongoing initiatives.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In particular, this morning I am delighted to announce a new program that formalizes the Federal Reserve's long-standing commitment to minority-owned depository institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, I will discuss several ongoing supervisory and regulatory initiatives that aim to improve consumer information and expand consumer protection.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Federal Reserve System's Minority-Owned Institutions (MOI) Program Nationally, there about 200 minority-owned depository institutions serving a broad range of communities and populations.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These banks have long played a unique and important role in our banking system by providing access to credit and financial services in markets that have historically been underserved.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve, which supervises just under twenty of these institutions, is committed to promoting the success of the minority-owned depository institutions we oversee.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Supporting these institutions is fundamental to our overall supervisory responsibilities for ensuring a safe, sound, and competitive banking system that also protects consumers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: We have consistently provided ongoing assistance, through our regulatory, supervisory, and community development functions, to address the unique challenges and needs of minority-owned banks, while at the same time holding them to the high standards of supervisory performance.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve has tapped the expertise at the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia to spearhead development of a proactive training and technical assistance program for minority-owned depository institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The new minority-owned institutions (MOI) program I will discuss today reflects our experience in addressing the needs of these institutions as well as the insights offered in a recent report issued by the Government Accountability Office .
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In developing the program, Federal Reserve staff met with a number of minority-owned and de novo banking organizations across the country, as well as trade groups, bank consultants, and other federal banking agencies, to gain the insight into the challenges the organizations confront in raising capital, growing their institutions, and attracting talent.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: This process provided valuable insight into the needs of minority-owned banks and contributed significantly to the design of the program.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The outreach and market research efforts also informed our understanding of the various issues that de novo and smaller institutions face in general.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: As a result, some elements of the curriculum may ultimately have broader applicability.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Certainly, the components that address broad challenges, coupled with more-targeted training, will address the unique information and technical assistance needs of minority-owned banks.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: To ensure broad access to the program, all aspects of the training program will be available through a variety of distribution channels:  classroom-style workshops, self-paced PC-based programs, and a web-based resource and information center.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The innovative MOI program consists of three modules, each focusing on issues that are most relevant at a particular point in a bank's life cycle:  "Starting Up," "Managing Initial Growth," and "Managing a Mature Institution."
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The program thus will be valuable for potential entrants as well as those that have been in the market for many years.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: I think of the new MOI program as a type of course of study in a contemporary MBA curriculum, one that draws on insights and experiences from economics, accounting, finance, and compliance and focuses on the particular challenges of establishing and sustaining robust and vibrant minority-owned depository institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The first module, "Starting Up," addresses the steps in filing an application and other issues related to a bank's chartering process, such as raising capital, assembling a successful board and management team, and conducting market analyses.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The second module, "Managing Initial Growth," targets institutions that are managing growth and other transitions that occur during the first five years of their existence.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Training at this stage focuses on the institution's need to stabilize operations in a competitive environment and addresses issues essential to sustainability, such as maintaining capital and liquidity, managing credit and interest rate risk, ensuring compliance with banking laws and regulations, and developing new products.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The third module, "Managing a Mature Institution," focuses on growing the institution and shareholder value.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Participants in this portion of the training will learn more about how to achieve growth targets in a safe and sound manner, measure performance of the board and management team, and expand their market.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: While these training modules are comprehensive in scope, the course designers recognize that there may be additional information and training needs.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: A great deal of flexibility is being built into the curriculum, so that an expanded version of the modules can be provided to institutions that have specific concerns or issues.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, each module features a section on supervisory and regulatory relations, to help build and maintain a strong dialogue between minority-owned banks and their regulators.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The program also provides for quality control and continuing assessment, through such elements as instructor coaching and curriculum evaluation, to ensure that the course remains responsive to the target audiences' needs.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: I am also excited about a related benefit of the new MOI program--the possibility of enhancing the Federal Reserve's role as a supervisor of these banks.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Concepts underpinning the MOI training program are being incorporated into our examiner education curricula, providing an opportunity for a deeper understanding within the supervision community of the issues unique to minority-owned depositories.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: This responds directly to the interests expressed by participants in the outreach and market research phase of program development.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Many of the bankers indicated that it was important to improve understanding of their business models and strategies among the supervisory agencies, while at the same time holding their minority-owned institutions to the same supervisory standards as other depository institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: A pilot program will be launched this fall, with a number of workshops to be held in selected Federal Reserve Districts and a roll-out of some web-based training.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Throughout the pilot period and after launch of the full program in early 2008, the Federal Reserve will continue to work with the industry and interagency partners to identify ways to increase the training's responsiveness.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: This innovative MOI initiative underscores our commitment to providing essential information and supervisory support that helps institutions both improve their operating efficiency--thereby reducing costs and, ultimately, regulatory burden--and enhance their ability to serve their communities more effectively.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Federal Reserve's Functions and Roles in Bank Oversight and Consumer Protection
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve's MOI program demonstrates a long-standing commitment to fostering a banking system that is competitive, diverse, and fair, to the benefit of both banking organizations and consumers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Toward this end, we use all the supervisory, regulatory, and other tools available to us.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: One example is the recently issued proposal on interagency Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) guidelines, which seeks to affirm that banks' investments in minority-owned banks receive favorable consideration under the investment test.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Now I'd like to discuss some of those tools and several recent Federal Reserve initiatives to address current issues of concern, with an emphasis on consumer protection.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve fulfills its consumer protection mandate through four complementary processes.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The first process is examining supervised financial institutions for safety and soundness, and for compliance with consumer protection laws and regulations.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: This includes taking supervisory action as appropriate to enforce the laws and resolve any consumer complaints.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The second is rulewriting--issuing regulations, either separately or jointly with other federal agencies, to implement the consumer financial services and fair lending laws.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The third is promoting consumer education through publications and through partnerships with other organizations.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: And the fourth is promoting community development and fair and impartial access to credit by conducting outreach activities in lower-income communities and traditionally underserved markets.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Supervisory Efforts on Subprime Mortgage Lending With respect to supervision, the Federal Reserve exercises its examination and enforcement authority to monitor and address issues of concern at the banks it oversees.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, we often issue guidance to provide the industry with supervisory "best practices" for addressing safety and soundness and consumer protection matters.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Guidance is generally a more-responsive supervisory tool than rules, and it allows institutions more flexibility in adopting new business practices.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Over the years, the Federal Reserve, in concert with other supervisory agencies, has issued a series of supervisory guidance documents to address subprime and nontraditional mortgage lending issues.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The guidance has underscored the importance of a well-structured risk-management program for subprime lenders and has stressed that lending standards should include well-defined underwriting parameters, such as acceptable loan-to-value ratios and debt-to-income ratios, and minimum acceptable credit scores.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Guidance has also been used to address common predatory and abusive lending practices, including making unaffordable loans, inducing a borrower to refinance a loan repeatedly to generate fee income, and engaging in fraud or deception to conceal the true nature of the loan obligation.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Most recently, supervisory guidance has emphasized the added dimension of risk when higher-risk loans are combined with other features--such as the use of simultaneous second lien loans in lieu of a down payment or the use of underwriting that involves little or no documentation of income or assets.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Guidance has also underscored the safety and soundness and consumer protection concerns prompted by other underwriting practices often seen in subprime and nontraditional mortgage lending, such as excluding taxes and insurance in the underwriting process and allowing deferred repayment of principal by offering interest-only loans.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Finally, this supervisory tool has been used to urge creditors to work with homeowners who are unable to make mortgage payments.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Reviews of Non-Depository Subprime Mortgage Lenders This supervisory guidance, together with market forces, has contributed to adjustments in subprime lending practices, particularly by federally supervised banks.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: However, we are all keenly aware that ongoing issues in the subprime market require additional action to address the very real and significant impact that rising delinquencies and foreclosures are having on individuals and communities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Various outreach and research efforts by the Federal Reserve have deepened our understanding of the issues and revealed that many of the most-worrisome practices are found in credit extensions by nondepository lenders and brokers, many of which are outside the supervisory scope of the federal banking agencies.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve Board is committed to deterring abusive lending and ensuring that all lenders are complying with consumer protection laws.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: To that end, the Board has taken the lead in launching a pilot project involving consumer compliance reviews of selected nondepository lenders that have significant subprime mortgage operations.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Board's partners in the project are the Office of Thrift Supervision, the Federal Trade Commission, and the states (through the Conference of State Bank Supervisors and the American Association of Residential Mortgage Regulators).
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: As part of this project, the Board will examine nonbank subsidiaries of bank holding companies for compliance with laws that the Federal Reserve enforces.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These laws include the Truth in Lending Act, the Equal Credit Opportunity Act, the Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act, the Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act, and the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The other partners in the project will conduct similar reviews of nondepository subsidiaries of thrift holding companies, independent mortgage lending companies, and mortgage brokers doing business with these entities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The partner agencies will share information about the examinations, review the lessons learned, and seek additional ways to cooperate to ensure effective and consistent supervision of these entities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: At the conclusion of the reviews, the agencies will analyze the results and determine whether the project is to be continued and, if so, what the focus of future reviews will be.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Regulatory Initiatives In addition to exercising supervisory authority, the Federal Reserve is using its regulatory power to review the Truth in Lending Act (TILA) regulations , with the intent of making the disclosures that help consumers understand their loan terms more effective.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: To be effective, disclosures must give consumers information about credit pricing at a time when the information is relevant, in language they can easily understand.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The information must also be in a format that allows consumers to pick out and use the information that is most important to them.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Better credit disclosure facilitates better-informed credit decisions, and hence more-effective competition among creditors.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In a nutshell, effective disclosure empowers consumers and enhances competition.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve Board has recently taken a new approach to increasing the effectiveness of disclosure--namely, surveying and responding to consumers through consumer testing.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Having taught at a business school for many years, I am well aware of the types of consumer testing that firms have long employed:  surveys, focus groups, and so-called "mall intercepts," whereby shoppers are interviewed at random.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Systematically using such techniques to tailor the disclosure requirements set out in the regulations of the Federal Reserve and other financial regulators is, however, relatively novel.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: After extensive consumer testing, the Board issued a proposal in May that reflects consumers' thoughts on clearer and easier-to-understand credit card disclosures.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In particular, the proposed disclosures would highlight applicable rates and fees, especially penalties that might be imposed.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The proposed rules would also require card issuers to provide forty-five days' advance notice of a rate increase or any other change in account terms so that consumers will not be surprised by unexpected charges and will have time to explore alternatives.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Recognizing the value of public input and our experiences in consumer testing, the Board is now engaged in a similar review of the TILA rules for mortgage loans.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: This process began last summer when the Board convened four public hearings across the country to gather information on the adequacy of current mortgage disclosures, particularly disclosures for nontraditional and adjustable-rate products.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: As with credit card lending, the Board is committed to conducting extensive consumer testing of proposed mortgage disclosures to identify what information consumers need, use, and retain when embarking on a search for a mortgage.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The process of designing and testing disclosures is necessarily time intensive.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: However, it is a valuable investment, one that will ensure that we have a thorough review resulting in a substantive proposal that presents meaningful new disclosures.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Simultaneously, the Federal Reserve is undertaking other projects that can be implemented more quickly.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: For example, the Board plans to respond to concerns about misleading or incomplete marketing practices in the mortgage market.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: By the end of the year, we will propose changes to TILA rules concerning mortgage loan advertisements and solicitations.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These proposed rules will also address issues relating to the timing of disclosures, to ensure not only that consumers get the information they need, but that they get it when it would be most useful to them.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve recognizes that disclosures may not be sufficient to protect consumers from harmful mortgage products or terms.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Therefore, the Board plans to exercise its authority under the Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act (HOEPA) to address specific practices that are unfair or deceptive.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In June, I chaired a daylong public hearing at which we received valuable insight from both industry and consumer groups into the impact of specific mortgage practices on subprime borrowers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Some of the practices we are looking at are pre-payment penalties, the waiver of escrow accounts for taxes and insurance, and the proliferation of stated-income or low-documentation loans.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Concerns have also been expressed about underwriting standards that do not fully take into consideration the borrower's ability to repay.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Board is closely examining these issues and discussing possible remedies.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: We expect to propose rules under HOEPA later this year.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Community Affairs and Consumer Education Roles The Federal Reserve also looks beyond its supervisory and regulatory functions to address concerns of information asymmetries and access to financial services in local markets.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: A core principle of economics is that markets are more competitive, and therefore more efficient, when accurate information is available to both consumers and suppliers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve dedicates considerable resources to community development and consumer education efforts designed to help facilitate the flow of accurate information to communities and consumers, particularly those that have been traditionally underserved.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Board, each of the twelve Federal Reserve Banks, and many of the Branch offices have a Community Affairs Office (CAO).
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These offices work to promote community development and fair and impartial access to credit by focusing on low- and moderate-income consumers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The community affairs function develops programs, partnerships, and initiatives that bring consumers into the financial and economic mainstream and that assist financial institutions in identifying viable opportunities in markets that may be underserved.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The CAOs also engage in research to help improve understanding of how financial services policies and practices affect lower-income households and neighborhoods.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, the Federal Reserve has a robust consumer education program.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Through our consumer education publications, programs, and partnerships, the Federal Reserve informs consumers about financial transactions and the regulations that govern those transactions, to help them understand consumer protections and their rights when shopping for various products.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: For example, the Board has published brochures to assist consumers when they are shopping for a credit card, looking for a mortgage, or leasing a vehicle.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: We have also published brochures to help consumers understand their checking accounts and overdraft protection programs and to educate them on the effects of having their payments processed electronically.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Recently the Board has focused on helping consumers better understand nontraditional mortgage products and adjustable-rate mortgages (ARMs) and has prepared a consumer publication on these products.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In June, we launched an online mortgage calculator that allows consumers to easily compare their monthly payments, and the amount of equity they will build, under several kinds of fixed- and adjustable-rate mortgages.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In my time at the Federal Reserve, I have had the opportunity to see the benefits that community development and consumer education efforts offer.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: As noted earlier, I am actively involved with the work of the Board's Division of Consumer and Community Affairs through my chairmanship of the oversight committee.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, I am pleased to be serving on the board of NeighborWorks America ® , a national nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting and preserving affordable housing for low- and moderate-income families and neighborhoods.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These roles give me valuable insight into the complexity of the financial services issues in these markets as well as an appreciation of the organizations and institutions that are committed to understanding these challenges and designing creative solutions to overcome them.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Conclusion In closing, I would like thank you for the opportunity to underscore the Federal Reserve's commitment to promoting the vibrant, competitive, and diverse banking markets that are so vital to our economy.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: We are dedicated to using our roles as supervisors, regulators, community development facilitators, and consumer educators to support the banking organizations that contribute to our robust financial services system--and the consumers who are vital to that system's success.
speech_title: Federal Reserve Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: At the Interagency Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Miami, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In my remarks this morning, I will begin with some observations about recent market developments and their economic implications.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: I will then try to place recent events in a broader historical context by discussing the evolution of housing markets and housing finance in the United States.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, I will argue that, over the years, institutional changes in U.S. housing and mortgage markets have significantly influenced both the transmission of monetary policy and the economy's cyclical dynamics.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: As our system of housing finance continues to evolve, understanding these linkages not only provides useful insights into the past but also holds the promise of helping us better cope with the implications of future developments.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Recent Developments in Financial markets and the Economy I will begin my review of recent developments by discussing the housing situation.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: As you know, the downturn in the housing market, which began in the summer of 2005, has been sharp.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Sales of new and existing homes have declined significantly from their mid-2005 peaks and have remained slow in recent months.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: As demand has weakened, house prices have decelerated or even declined by some measures, and homebuilders have scaled back their construction of new homes.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The cutback in residential construction has directly reduced the annual rate of U.S. economic growth about 3/4 percentage point on average over the past year and a half.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Despite the slowdown in construction, the stock of unsold new homes remains quite elevated relative to sales, suggesting that further declines in homebuilding are likely.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The outlook for home sales and construction will also depend on unfolding developments in mortgage markets.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: A substantial increase in lending to nonprime borrowers contributed to the bulge in residential investment in 2004 and 2005, and the tightening of credit conditions for these borrowers likely accounts for some of the continued softening in demand we have seen this year.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: As I will discuss, recent market developments have resulted in additional tightening of rates and terms for nonprime borrowers as well as for potential borrowers through "jumbo" mortgages.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Obviously, if current conditions persist in mortgage markets, the demand for homes could weaken further, with possible implications for the broader economy.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: We are following these developments closely.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: As house prices have softened, and as interest rates have risen from the low levels of a couple of years ago, we have seen a marked deterioration in the performance of nonprime mortgages.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The problems have been most severe for subprime mortgages with adjustable rates:  the proportion of those loans with serious delinquencies rose to about 13-1/2 percent in June, more than double the recent low seen in mid-2005.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: 1 The adjustable-rate subprime mortgages originated in late 2005 and in 2006 have performed the worst, in part because of slippage in underwriting standards, reflected for example in high loan-to-value ratios and incomplete documentation.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: With many of these borrowers facing their first interest rate resets in coming quarters, and with softness in house prices expected to continue to impede refinancing, delinquencies among this class of mortgages are likely to rise further.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Apart from adjustable-rate subprime mortgages, however, the deterioration in performance has been less pronounced, at least to this point.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: For subprime mortgages with fixed rather than variable rates, for example, serious delinquencies have been fairly stable at about 5-1/2 percent.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The rate of serious delinquencies on alt-A securitized pools rose to nearly 3 percent in June, from a low of less than 1 percent in mid-2005.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Delinquency rates on prime jumbo mortgages have also risen, though they are lower than those for prime conforming loans, and both rates are below 1 percent.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Investors' concerns about mortgage credit performance have intensified sharply in recent weeks, reflecting, among other factors, worries about the housing market and the effects of impending interest-rate resets on borrowers' ability to remain current.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Credit spreads on new securities backed by subprime mortgages, which had jumped earlier this year, rose significantly more in July.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Issuance of such securities has been negligible since then, as dealers have faced difficulties placing even the AAA-rated tranches.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Issuance of securities backed by alt-A and prime jumbo mortgages also has fallen sharply, as investors have evidently become concerned that the losses associated with these types of mortgages may be higher than had been expected.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: With securitization impaired, some major lenders have announced the cancellation of their adjustable-rate subprime lending programs.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: A number of others that specialize in nontraditional mortgages have been forced by funding pressures to scale back or close down.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Some lenders that sponsor asset-backed commercial paper conduits as bridge financing for their mortgage originations have been unable to "roll" the maturing paper, forcing them to draw on back-up liquidity facilities or to exercise options to extend the maturity of their paper.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: As a result of these developments, borrowers face noticeably tighter terms and standards for all but conforming mortgages.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: As you know, the financial stress has not been confined to mortgage markets.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The markets for asset-backed commercial paper and for lower-rated unsecured commercial paper market also have suffered from pronounced declines in investor demand, and the associated flight to quality has contributed to surges in the demand for short-dated Treasury bills, pushing T-bill rates down sharply on some days.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Swings in stock prices have been sharp, with implied price volatilities rising to about twice the levels seen in the spring.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Credit spreads for a range of financial instruments have widened, notably for lower-rated corporate credits.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Diminished demand for loans and bonds to finance highly leveraged transactions has increased some banks' concerns that they may have to bring significant quantities of these instruments onto their balance sheets.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: These banks, as well as those that have committed to serve as back-up facilities to commercial paper programs, have become more protective of their liquidity and balance-sheet capacity.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Although this episode appears to have been triggered largely by heightened concerns about subprime mortgages, global financial losses have far exceeded even the most pessimistic projections of credit losses on those loans.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: In part, these wider losses likely reflect concerns that weakness in U.S. housing will restrain overall economic growth.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: But other factors are also at work.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Investor uncertainty has increased significantly, as the difficulty of evaluating the risks of structured products that can be opaque or have complex payoffs has become more evident.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Also, as in many episodes of financial stress, uncertainty about possible forced sales by leveraged participants and a higher cost of risk capital seem to have made investors hesitant to take advantage of possible buying opportunities.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: More generally, investors may have become less willing to assume risk.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Some increase in the premiums that investors require to take risk is probably a healthy development on the whole, as these premiums have been exceptionally low for some time.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, in this episode, the shift in risk attitudes has interacted with heightened concerns about credit risks and uncertainty about how to evaluate those risks to create significant market stress.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: On the positive side of the ledger, we should recognize that past efforts to strengthen capital positions and the financial infrastructure place the global financial system in a relatively strong position to work through this process.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the statement following its August 7 meeting, the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) recognized that the rise in financial volatility and the tightening of credit conditions for some households and businesses had increased the downside risks to growth somewhat but reiterated that inflation risks remained its predominant policy concern.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: In subsequent days, however, following several events that led investors to believe that credit risks might be larger and more pervasive than previously thought, the functioning of financial markets became increasingly impaired.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Liquidity dried up and spreads widened as many market participants sought to retreat from certain types of asset exposures altogether.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Well-functioning financial markets are essential for a prosperous economy.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: As the nation's central bank, the Federal Reserve seeks to promote general financial stability and to help to ensure that financial markets function in an orderly manner.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: In response to the developments in the financial markets in the period following the FOMC meeting, the Federal Reserve provided reserves to address unusual strains in money markets.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: On August 17, the Federal Reserve Board announced a cut in the discount rate of 50 basis points and adjustments in the Reserve Banks' usual discount window practices to facilitate the provision of term financing for as long as thirty days, renewable by the borrower.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve also took a number of supplemental actions, such as cutting the fee charged for lending Treasury securities.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The purpose of the discount window actions was to assure depositories of the ready availability of a backstop source of liquidity.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Even if banks find that borrowing from the discount window is not immediately necessary, the knowledge that liquidity is available should help alleviate concerns about funding that might otherwise constrain depositories from extending credit or making markets.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve stands ready to take additional actions as needed to provide liquidity and promote the orderly functioning of markets.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: It is not the responsibility of the Federal Reserve--nor would it be appropriate--to protect lenders and investors from the consequences of their financial decisions.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: But developments in financial markets can have broad economic effects felt by many outside the markets, and the Federal Reserve must take those effects into account when determining policy.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: In a statement issued simultaneously with the discount window announcement, the FOMC indicated that the deterioration in financial market conditions and the tightening of credit since its August 7 meeting had appreciably increased the downside risks to growth.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, the further tightening of credit conditions, if sustained, would increase the risk that the current weakness in housing could be deeper or more prolonged than previously expected, with possible adverse effects on consumer spending and the economy more generally.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The incoming data indicate that the economy continued to expand at a moderate pace into the summer, despite the sharp correction in the housing sector.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, in light of recent financial developments, economic data bearing on past months or quarters may be less useful than usual for our forecasts of economic activity and inflation.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Consequently, we will pay particularly close attention to the timeliest indicators, as well as information gleaned from our business and banking contacts around the country.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Inevitably, the uncertainty surrounding the outlook will be greater than normal, presenting a challenge to policymakers to manage the risks to their growth and price stability objectives.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Committee continues to monitor the situation and will act as needed to limit the adverse effects on the broader economy that may arise from the disruptions in financial markets.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Beginnings:  Mortgage Markets in the Early Twentieth Century Like us, our predecessors grappled with the economic and policy implications of innovations and institutional changes in housing finance.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the remainder of my remarks, I will try to set the stage for this weekend's conference by discussing the historical evolution of the mortgage market and some of the implications of that evolution for monetary policy and the economy.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: The early decades of the twentieth century are a good starting point for this review, as urbanization and the exceptionally rapid population growth of that period created a strong demand for new housing.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Between 1890 and 1930, the number of housing units in the United States grew from about 10 million to about 30 million; the pace of homebuilding was particularly brisk during the economic boom of the 1920s.
speech_title: Housing, Housing Finance, and Monetary Policy
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: Remarkably, this rapid expansion of the housing stock took place despite limited sources of mortgage financing and typical lending terms that were far less attractive than those to which we are accustomed today.

speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke

text: No discussion of the New Deal's effect on the housing market and the monetary transmission mechanism would be complete without reference to Regulation Q--which was eventually to exemplify the law of unintended consequences.

speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming

speaker: Bernanke
text: With the ceilings in place, banks and thrifts experienced what came to be known as disintermediation--an outflow of funds from depositories that occurred whenever short-term money-market rates rose above the maximum that these institutions could pay.

text: The Emergence of Capital Markets as a Source of Housing Finance The manifest problems associated with relying on short-term deposits to fund long-term mortgage lending set in train major changes in financial markets and financial instruments, which collectively served to link mortgage lending more closely to the broader capital markets.

speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City's Economic Symposium, Jackson Hole, Wyoming
