speaker: Kroszner
text: I am delighted to have been invited by GARP to share a few of my thoughts about risk management practices at financial institutions.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Recent events remind us that markets can be quite complex and difficult to predict and that sound risk management is fundamental to the health and resiliency of both individual financial institutions and financial markets generally.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Today I want to highlight two fundamental elements of sound risk management: information and incentives.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: These two elements lie at the very heart of good risk management.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Information is vital to good decisionmaking, and incentives send the right signals and create beneficial outcomes both within individual institutions and to the financial system as a whole.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: I should note that my thoughts on recent events are preliminary.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Because risk-management challenges have affected a number of global institutions, we are working very closely with our supervisory counterparts in other countries to learn from recent events and to coordinate with financial institutions in determining what additional steps may need to be taken.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: As part of this important international effort, we should seek to align market participants' incentives with our own supervisory objectives; otherwise, behavior will not be altered appropriately and the proposed remedies will not prove durable.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Key Elements of Sound Risk Management As is well known to the impressive international group of risk professionals in this audience, models are critical to understanding the nuances of risks embedded in complex financial transactions and portfolios, but I am sure all of you would agree that sophisticated techniques cannot be relied upon without the proper risk-management foundation.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Integral to this foundation are timely and accurate information and the will and ability to act on it.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Since the fortunes of even the most technically sophisticated financial institutions ultimately depend on the decisions and judgments of individual managers and traders, senior management must ensure that the right incentives are in place so that risk taking is appropriately captured in business-line performance evaluation and employee compensation.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Senior management must understand the risks assumed by each individual business line and communicate the firm's strategy and risk appetite back down to those business lines.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: At the same time, senior management must send each business-line manager clear signals about which risk levels are tolerable and which practices are not acceptable.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In this way, information and incentives are threads of sound risk management that must be woven into the fabric of each firm's management culture.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: A good risk-management structure must encompass risks across the entire firm, gathering and processing information on an enterprise-wide basis in real time.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Good information is the lifeblood of sound risk management.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In short, you cannot manage your risks if you do not know what they are.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Managers of financial institutions need to ensure that they fully understand the risks assumed by each of their institutions' business lines, and for that they need high-quality information--both qualitative and quantitative.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Aggregating information across a large, diversified financial institution is not easy and should be done with appropriate care and with adequate resources for checking timeliness and veracity.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Risk managers should live by the adage "Trust but verify," being careful not to rely on assessments or data from others without conducting proper due diligence.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: It is also worth noting that financial institutions should gather a wide range of relevant information before they see market troubles brewing.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In other words, scrambling for information once turbulence sets in is not good practice.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Understanding a firm's true risk exposures requires examining not just risks on the balance sheet, but also off-balance-sheet risks that are sometimes more difficult to identify and often not so easy to quantify.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Latent risks from certain complex products and certain risky activities should be properly recognized, because they can manifest themselves when market turbulence sets in.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Stress testing and scenario analysis are of paramount importance here.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Even when risks are properly identified and measured, that information needs to be presented to senior management and to others in the firm who can use it in their decisionmaking, and presented in a timely way.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In other words, information should be adequately distributed both vertically and horizontally.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Adequate distribution of information allows for an enterprise-wide perspective on risks that affect the whole organization.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Information must be provided up to senior management, but their views and analysis then must be sent back down through the business lines.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: To put it another way, institutions should develop an "information circulatory system" to ensure the flow of information that is crucial to the health of the firm.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: It is also clear that financial institutions should draw on several types of information from various sources when assessing their risks, particularly when dealing with complex products.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: No single source of information is perfect or adequate.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Management benefits from having a number of tools at its disposal to assess risk positions that draw on differing underlying assumptions.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Properly designed, these tools offer different perspectives on exposures and are flexible enough to allow perspectives on risk to change as business conditions change and new data become available.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: To ensure sound risk management, boards of directors and senior management at financial institutions must also establish an overall governance and control structure that is credible, robust, and consistent throughout the firm.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: It is critical that senior management set the tone at the top, communicate it, and lead by example.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: This strategy should be clearly articulated and should be recognizable in the actions of the firm's employees.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Business lines should be held equally accountable and there should not be any special treatment for "star" employees, even if they are bringing sizable revenues into the institution in a particularly year.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: While certain financial institutions may choose to conduct business on a decentralized basis, they must always remember that in the end the exposures and obligations are rolled up and combined into one consolidated legal entity.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, the institution's commitment to and emphasis on risk management should be eminently visible--both within and outside of the organization.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: For example, the firm should demonstrate that its risk managers have direct access to top management and play a key role in decisionmaking.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: They also must be able to speak authoritatively about the risk profile and risk-management strategy of the whole organization to market participants and counterparties.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Of course, risk-management structures are successful only if they are sturdy and durable.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: These structures and their associated strategies should be embedded in the firm's culture and not be dependent on just one or a few people.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: They should be part of the fabric of the organization, not just a few catchy phrases repeated from time to time.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: For example, understanding and living up to the firm's risk-management standards should be a prerequisite for advancement to a senior management position.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Effective risk management remains sturdy and durable only if supported by strong and independent risk functions that produce unbiased information.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Having independent risk managers with a certain amount of authority allows for clear, dispassionate thinking about the entire firm's risk profile, with no favoritism toward any business unit.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Senior management should encourage risk managers to dig deep to uncover latent risks and point out cases in which certain business lines are assuming too much risk.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In other words, it is good to have a few people within the institution who--to paraphrase a former Federal Reserve Chairman--know when to take away the punch bowl.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Being the party pooper, however, can be very difficult in any organization, and that is why it is crucial for the risk manager to be known as an independent voice who is influential with top management.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Ensuring Adherence to Risk-Management Practices
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Any successful organization needs to develop appropriate mechanisms to ensure adherence to and sustainability of its risk-management structures, and incentives structures are a key mechanism for this purpose.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Appropriate incentives reward good behavior and penalize inappropriate behavior.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Of course, incentives work best when they are known well in advance, that is, when they serve as ex ante signals of what should and should not be done.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Naturally, in very large organizations it is difficult for senior management to monitor each individual, so incentives need to be consistent, permeate even the lowest levels of the organization, and remind each individual that his or her risk-taking affects the whole enterprise.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Limits and controls can be useful tools for creating the right incentives and sending appropriate signals, but they of course need to be tailored individually to each firm.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Problems can arise when incentives are not properly structured and appropriate "risk discipline" is not exercised--for example, when limits and controls are not set or, if they are set, when adherence to them is not monitored or enforced.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Such controls are incentives for business-line leaders to assume only the risks that the firm can absorb because they penalize those who try to take on excessive risk or inadequate mitigation in the name of short-term profit maximization.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: One good practice is to have reliable, interconnected enforcement mechanisms within the institution, mechanisms that can--and will--enforce limits.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: An example is a good centralized treasury function.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Risk-Adjusted Performance Evaluation and Compensation
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In trading and certain other activities, there is a tendency for business-line heads or individual employees to focus on their short-term compensation and not think about the long-term risks that their activities create for the firm.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: But it is the responsibility of senior management to provide the proper incentives and controls to counter the potential for individuals within financial firms to discount risks to the broader institution, and of course to ensure that nefarious activity is promptly uncovered and stopped.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Clearly, it is up to financial institutions themselves--not bank supervisors--to decide how compensation should be structured, but managers and boards of directors should understand the consequences of providing too many short-term and one-sided incentives.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: They would benefit from thinking about compensation on more of a risk-adjusted basis.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Accordingly, I encourage institutions to think about ways to alter existing compensation schemes to include some types of deferred compensation, since the risks of certain investments or trades may not manifest themselves in the near term.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Thus, it makes sense to try to match the tenor of compensation with the tenor of the risk profile and thus explicitly to take into account the longer-run performance of the portfolio or division in which the employee operates.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: This type of compensation arrangement is already in use at many nonfinancial firms.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Of course, star performers may prefer to have compensation more front-loaded and threaten to leave a firm for another one that would not have the same longer-term risk-sensitive compensation structure.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: It is important for firms to have the flexibility to choose how they reward their employees, but it may be valuable to consider the development of industry-wide principles of sound risk management that would touch upon incentive-compensation issues.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Such principles could foster market discipline in firms if investors were to view the principles as best practices and were to more heavily discount the reported short-term earnings of firms that failed to adopt best practices.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Although reaching consensus on principles for compensation would be difficult, it seems well worth the effort.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Reflecting Risk-Management Practices outside the Firm
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Information and incentives play an important role not just within an institution, but also outside it.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: By this I mean the ability of the marketplace--and supervisors, when necessary--to gather information about financial institutions and give the right signals to bank management about risk taking.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Naturally, this requires proper disclosure of information by the financial institution so that depositors, counterparties, shareholders, and other market participants can judge the riskiness of the institution and act accordingly.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Institutions that are able to provide a continual and accurate flow of information to market participants generally benefit from such transparency.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Certainly, this is an important part of the motivation behind pillar 3 of the new Basel II capital rules emphasizing the role of public disclosure.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: This benefit can be even more prominent during financial turbulence, when market participants become fearful of latent risks and "surprise" losses.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Confidence in the risk-management practices of individual firms can be valuable in maintaining confidence in the markets in which they operate.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Risk-Management Performance during Recent Market Events Although some of the risk-management techniques applied during the past nine months were successful, in other areas challenges remain.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In risk identification and quantification, as well as liquidity-risk management, for example, the importance of information and incentives is evident.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: A number of risk-measurement and risk-quantification challenges relate to valuation practices, particularly with new products.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: As I noted in a speech last fall, firms should have greater motivation for applying proper valuation practices as part of good risk management.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: 1 At the center of these practices is the ability to make appropriate judgments about the quality of information being used for valuations.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: The process usually starts with an initial experimentation phase in which market participants learn a great deal about the product's expected performance and risk characteristics, preferably under different market conditions.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Conducting due diligence about new products can be costly and take time, but it is usually worth it.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Unfortunately, in some recent cases new products were developed very quickly and not properly road tested.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In observing the valuation challenges, the "Trust but verify" adage has equal application.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Market participants must ensure that they do not make valuation decisions based solely on excessive reliance on external ratings or evaluations, but that they also undertake their own assessment.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: And I would suggest that the value of independent due diligence on the part of market participants is especially high for newer and more-complex products.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: We all know that reductions in market liquidity played a large role in recent events, affecting the valuation of financial products.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: As with other risk areas, a number of practices were applied over the past nine months to identify and try to quantify the potential for disruptions in market liquidity.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Good practices included attempts by business lines and trading desks to embed market-liquidity premiums or to apply market-liquidity haircuts in pricing models and valuations.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: That is, there was an understanding that information in benign periods did not reveal the full set of potential outcomes, and that disruption of market liquidity had the potential to affect market prices by driving down the value of certain instruments and to create losses.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Conversely, problems arose when some managers did not make market-liquidity adjustments in their quantitative estimates and models and simply relied on recent information from good times, when there was ample liquidity.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Basel Committee's working group on liquidity began an exercise to review liquidity-supervision practices early last year and just last week issued a public report that builds on the Basel sound practices for managing liquidity risk issued in 2000.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: The report emphasizes that financial institutions should conduct stress tests and contingency planning exercises to prepare for potential problems in both funding and market liquidity, capturing market-wide events, events affecting multiple markets or currencies simultaneously, and the combination of idiosyncratic and market-wide shocks.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In conducting this analysis, firms should better integrate stress tests and contingency funding plans.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: As with other risk areas, weaker performance in funding and liquidity-risk management can sometimes stem from inadequate information and poor incentives.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: During recent events, firmwide liquidity-management strategies were most effective when they included proper incentives and all relevant information, including information about the potential for certain exposures to be added to a firm's balance sheet--so-called unplanned asset expansions.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Successful plans also contained information about the potential liquidity needs of individual business lines and how those might affect funding for the entire organization.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In other words, individual business lines were instructed to evaluate their likely needs for funding and relate those needs to the treasury function.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: In some cases, managers have considered the potential adverse liquidity outcomes from engaging in certain businesses and therefore have decided to limit their involvement or stay out of those activities altogether.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Concluding Thoughts The banking industry has the primary responsibility for fostering a culture of effective risk management, but of course supervisors have their own role to play in ensuring the safety and soundness of individual firms and a viable financial system.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Therefore, both should continue to work hard to improve risk management in light of recent market events.
speech_title: Improving Risk Management in Light of Recent Market Events
speech_venue: At the Global Association of Risk Management Professionals Annual Risk Convention, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: The role of expectations illustrates two additional basic principles of monetary policy that help explain why stabilizing inflation helps stabilize economic activity: First, expectations of future policy actions and accompanying economic conditions play a crucial role in determining the effects of current policy actions on the economy.

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Second, monetary policy is most effective when the central bank is firmly committed, through its actions and statements, to a "nominal anchor"--such as to keeping inflation low and stable.

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: A strong commitment to stabilizing inflation helps anchor inflation expectations so that a central bank will not have to worry that expansionary policy to counter a negative demand shock will lead to a sharp rise in expected inflation--a so-called inflation scare (Goodfriend, 1993, 2005).

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

text: Thus, a strong commitment to a nominal anchor enables a central bank to react more aggressively to negative demand shocks and, therefore, to prevent rapid declines in employment or output.

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Unlike demand shocks, which drive inflation and economic activity in the same direction and thus present policymakers with a clear signal for how to adjust policy, supply shocks, such as the increases in the price of energy that we have been experiencing lately, drive inflation and output in opposite directions.

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: This research has also led to a deeper understanding of the benefits of price stability and the setting of monetary policy in response to changes in economic activity and inflation.

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: In particular, research has emphasized the interaction between stabilizing inflation and economic activity and has found that price stability can contribute to overall economic stability in a range of circumstances.

speaker: Mishkin
text: The intuition that leads to the conclusion that stabilizing inflation promotes maximum sustainable output and employment is simple, and it holds in a range of economic models whose policy prescriptions have been dubbed the New Neoclassical Synthesis.

speaker: Mishkin
text: To begin, the prices of many goods and services adjust infrequently.

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Simulations with FRB/US, the model of the U.S. economy created and maintained by the staff of the Federal Reserve Board (Mishkin, 2007b), illustrate this point.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: To keep the simulations as simple as possible, I have assumed that the economy begins at full employment with both headline and core inflation at desired levels.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: The economy is then assumed to experience a shock that raises the world price of oil about $30 per barrel over two years; the shock is assumed to slowly dissipate thereafter.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: In each of two scenarios, a Taylor rule is assumed to govern the response of the federal funds rate; the only difference between the two scenarios is that in one, the federal funds rate responds to core personal consumption expenditures (PCE) inflation, whereas in the other, it responds to headline PCE inflation.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: 6 Figure 1 illustrates the results of those two scenarios.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: The federal funds rate jumps higher and faster when the central bank responds to headline inflation rather than to core inflation, as would be expected (top-left panel).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Likewise, responding to headline inflation pushes the unemployment rate markedly higher than otherwise in the early going (top-right panel), and produces an inflation rate that is slightly lower than otherwise, whether measured by core or headline indexes (bottom panels).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: More important, even for a shock as persistent as this one, the policy response under headline inflation has to be unwound in the sense that the federal funds rate must drop substantially below baseline once the first-round effects of the shock drop out of the inflation data.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: The basic point from these simulations is that monetary policy that responds to headline inflation rather than to core inflation in response to an oil price shock pushes unemployment markedly higher than monetary policy that responds to core inflation.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: In addition, because this policy has larger swings in the federal funds rate that must be reversed, it leads to more pronounced swings in unemployment.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: On the other hand, monetary policy that responds to core inflation does not lead to appreciably worse performance on stabilizing inflation than does monetary policy that responds to headline inflation.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Stabilizing core inflation, therefore, leads to better economic outcomes than stabilizing headline inflation.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Although the simplest sticky-price models imply that stabilizing sticky-price inflation and economic activity are two sides of the same coin, the presence of other frictions besides sticky prices can lead to instances in which completely stabilizing sticky-price inflation would not imply stabilizing employment (or output) around their natural rates.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: For example, in response to an increase in productivity (a positive technology shock), the real wage has to rise to reflect the higher marginal product of labor inputs, which requires either prices to fall or nominal wages to rise for employment to reach its natural rate.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: If both nominal wages and prices are sticky, a policy of completely stabilizing prices will force the necessary real wage adjustment to occur entirely through nominal wage adjustment, thereby impeding the adjustment of employment to its efficient level (Blanchard, 1997; Erceg, Henderson, and Levin, 2000).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Indeed, if wages are much stickier than prices, the best strategy is to stabilize nominal wage inflation rather than price inflation, thereby allowing price inflation to decline to achieve the required increase in real wages.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Fluctuations in inflation and economic activity induced by variation over time in sources of economic inefficiency, such as changes in the markups in goods and labor markets or inefficiencies in labor market search, could also drive a wedge between the goals of stabilizing inflation and economic activity (Blanchard and Galí, 2006; Galí, Gertler, and López-Salido, 2007).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: For example, in sectors of the economy subject to little competitive pressure, prices that firms set tend to be higher and output lower than would prevail under greater competition.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Monetary policy is, of course, unable to offset permanently high markups because of the principle, mentioned earlier, that the long-run Phillips curve is vertical.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: However, a temporary increase in monopoly power that raises markups would exert upward pressure on prices without, at the same time, reducing the productive potential of the economy.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: That would, indeed, be a case of a tradeoff between stabilizing inflation and stabilizing output.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: These examples narrow the degree to which the recent findings of congruence between stabilizing inflation and economic activity apply in all cases, but they do not necessarily overturn the findings.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: The example of sticky wages would not invalidate the view that stabilizing inflation stabilizes economic activity if wages are sticky, for example, because they are held constant in order to operate as an "insurance" contract between employers and workers (Goodfriend and King, 2001).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: And for many of the inefficient shocks that drive a wedge between the sustainable level of output and the level of output associated with price stability, monetary policy may be the wrong tool to offset their effects (Blanchard, 2005).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Of course, central banks at times will still face difficult decisions regarding the short-run tradeoff between stabilizing inflation and output.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: For example, judging from the fit of New Keynesian Phillips curves, a substantial fraction of overall inflation variability seems related to supply-type shocks that create a tradeoff between inflation and output-gap stabilization (Kiley, 2007b).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: But the key insight from recent research--that the interaction between inflation fluctuations and relative price distortions should lead to a focus on the stability of nominal prices that adjust sluggishly--will likely prove to have important practical implications that can help contribute to inflation and employment stabilization.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Stabilizing Inflation as a Robust Policy in the Presence of Uncertainty The discussion so far has been based on the premise that the central bank knows the efficient, or natural, rate of output or employment.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: However, the natural rates of employment and output cannot be directly observed and are subject to considerable uncertainty--particularly in real time.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Indeed, economists do not even agree on the economic theory or econometric methods that should be used to measure those rates.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: These concerns are perhaps even more severe in the most recent models, where fluctuations in natural rates of output or employment can be very substantial (for example, Rotemberg and Woodford, 1997; Edge, Kiley, and Laforte, forthcoming).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Furthermore, because the natural rates in the most recent models are defined as the counterfactual levels of output and employment that would be obtained if prices and wages were completely flexible, the estimated fluctuations in natural rates generated by the research are very sensitive to model specification.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: If a central bank errs in measuring the natural rates of output and employment, its attempts to stabilize economic activity at those mismeasured natural rates can lead to very poor outcomes.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: For example, most economists now agree that the natural unemployment rate shifted up for many years starting in the late 1960s and that the growth of potential output shifted down for a considerable time after 1970.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: However, perhaps because those shifts were not generally recognized until much later (Orphanides and van Norden, 2002; Orphanides, 2003), monetary policy in the 1970s seems to have been aimed at achieving unsustainable levels of output and employment.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Hence, policymakers may have unwittingly contributed to accelerating inflation that reached double digits by the end of the decade as well as undesirable swings in unemployment.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: And although subsequent monetary policy tightening was successful in regaining control of inflation, the toll was a severe recession in 1981-82, which pushed up the unemployment rate to around 10 percent.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Uncertainty about the natural rates of economic activity implies that less weight may need to be put on stabilizing output or employment around what is likely to be a mismeasured natural rate (Orphanides and Williams, 2002).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Furthermore, research with New Keynesian models has found that overall economic performance may be most efficiently achieved by policies with a heavy focus on stabilizing inflation (for example, Schmitt-Grohé and Uribe, 2007).
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Conclusion Because monetary policy has not one but two objectives, stabilizing inflation and stabilizing economic activity, it might seem obvious that those objectives would usually, if not always, conflict.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: As so often occurs with the "obvious," however, the impression turns out to be incorrect.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: The economic research that I have discussed today demonstrates, rather, that the objectives of price stability and stabilizing economic activity are often likely to be mutually reinforcing.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Thus, the answer to the title of this speech--"Does stabilizing inflation contribute to stabilizing economic activity?"
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: --is, for the most part, yes.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: A key policy recommendation from the past three decades of research in monetary economics is that monetary policy makers must always keep their eye on inflation and emphasize the importance of price stability in their actions and communications.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Doing so does not mean that monetary policy makers are less concerned about stabilizing economic activity.
speech_title: Does Stabilizing Inflation Contribute to Stabilizing Economic Activity?
speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina

speaker: Mishkin
text: Rather, by appropriately focusing on stabilizing inflation along the lines I have outlined here, monetary policy is more likely to better stabilize economic activity.

speech_venue: At East Carolina University's Beta Gamma Sigma Distinguished Lecture Series, Greenville, North Carolina
