speaker: Bernanke
text: Over the past year and a half, mortgage delinquencies have increased sharply, especially among riskier loans.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: This development has triggered a substantial and broad-based reassessment of risk in financial markets, and it has exacerbated the contraction in the housing sector.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In my remarks today, I will discuss the causes of the distress in the mortgage sector and then turn to the key question of what can be done in this environment to reduce preventable foreclosures.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Although I am aware, as you are, that community banks originated few subprime mortgages, community bankers are keenly interested in these issues; foreclosures not only create personal and financial distress for individual homeowners but also can significantly hurt neighborhoods where foreclosures cluster.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Efforts by both government and private-sector entities to reduce unnecessary foreclosures are helping, but more can, and should, be done.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Community bankers are well positioned to contribute to these efforts, given the strong relationships you have built with your customers and your communities.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Rise in Mortgage Delinquencies and Foreclosures Mortgage delinquencies began to rise in mid-2005 after several years at remarkably low levels.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The worst payment problems have been among subprime adjustable-rate mortgages (subprime ARMs); more than one-fifth of the 3.6 million loans outstanding were seriously delinquent at the end of 2007.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: 1 Delinquency rates have also risen for other types of mortgages, reaching 8 percent for subprime fixed-rate loans and 6 percent on adjustable-rate loans securitized in alt-A pools.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Lenders were on pace to have initiated roughly 1-1/2 million foreclosure proceedings last year, up from an average of fewer than 1 million foreclosure starts in the preceding two years.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: 2 More than one-half of the foreclosure starts in 2007 were on subprime mortgages.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The recent surge in delinquencies in subprime ARMs is closely linked to the fact that many of these borrowers have little or no equity in their homes.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, data collected under the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act suggest that nearly 40 percent of higher-priced home-purchase loans in 2006 involved a second mortgage (or "piggyback") loan.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Other data show that more than 40 percent of the subprime loans in the 2006 vintage had combined loan-to-value ratios in excess of 90 percent, a considerably higher share than earlier in the decade.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: 3 Often, in recent mortgage vintages, small down payments were combined with other risk factors, such as a lack of documentation of sufficient income to make the required loan payments.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: This weak underwriting might not have produced widespread payment problems had house prices continued to rise at the rapid pace seen earlier in the decade.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Rising prices provided leveraged borrowers with significant increases in home equity and, consequently, with greater financial flexibility.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Instead, as you know, house prices are now falling in many parts of the country.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The resulting decline in equity reduces both the ability and the financial incentive of stressed borrowers to remain in their homes.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Indeed, historically, borrowers with little or no equity have been substantially more likely than others to fall behind in their payments.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The large number of outstanding mortgages with negative amortization features may exacerbate this problem.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Delinquencies and foreclosures likely will continue to rise for a while longer, for several reasons.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: First, supply-demand imbalances in many housing markets suggest that some further declines in house prices are likely, implying additional reductions in borrowers' equity.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Second, many subprime borrowers are facing imminent resets of the interest rates on their mortgages.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In 2008, about 1â1/2 million loans, representing more than 40 percent of the outstanding stock of subprime ARMs, are scheduled to reset.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: We estimate that the interest rate on a typical subprime ARM scheduled to reset in the current quarter will increase from just above 8 percent to about 9-1/4 percent, raising the monthly payment by more than 10 percent, to $1,500 on average.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Declines in short-term interest rates and initiatives involving rate freezes will reduce the impact somewhat, but interest rate resets will nevertheless impose stress on many households.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the past, subprime borrowers were often able to avoid resets by refinancing, but currently that avenue is largely closed.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Borrowers are hampered not only by their lack of equity but also by the tighter credit conditions in mortgage markets.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: New securitizations of nonprime mortgages have virtually halted, and commercial banks have tightened their standards, especially for riskier mortgages.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Indeed, the available evidence suggests that private lenders are originating few nonprime loans at any terms.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: This situation calls for a vigorous response.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Measures to reduce preventable foreclosures could help not only stressed borrowers but also their communities and, indeed, the broader economy.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: At the level of the individual community, increases in foreclosed-upon and vacant properties tend to reduce house prices in the local area, affecting other homeowners and municipal tax bases.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: At the national level, the rise in expected foreclosures could add significantly to the inventory of vacant unsold homes--already at more than 2 million units at the end of 2007--putting further pressure on house prices and housing construction.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Helping Distressed Borrowers Policymakers and stakeholders have been working to find effective responses to the increases in delinquencies and foreclosures.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Steps that have been taken include initiating programs designed to expand refinancing opportunities and efforts to facilitate and increase the pace of loan workouts.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Troubled borrowers will always require individual attention, and the most immediate impacts of foreclosures are on local communities.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Thus, the support of counselors, lenders, and organizations with local ties is critical.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Of course, care must be taken in designing solutions.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Measures that lead to a sustainable outcome are to be preferred to temporary palliatives, which may only put off foreclosure and perhaps increase its ultimate costs.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Solutions should also be prudent and consistent with the safety and soundness of the lender.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Concerns about fairness and the need to minimize moral hazard add to the complexity of the issue; we want to help borrowers in trouble, but we do not want borrowers who have avoided problems through responsible financial management to feel that they are being unfairly penalized.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Let me turn now to some recent efforts to help distressed borrowers refinance.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The FHASecure plan, which the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) announced late last summer, offers qualified borrowers who are delinquent because of an interest rate reset the opportunity to refinance into an FHA-insured mortgage.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Recently, the Congress and Administration temporarily increased the maximum loan value eligible for FHA insurance, which should allow more borrowers, particularly those in communities with higher-priced homes, to qualify for this program and to be eligible for refinancing into FHA-insured loans more generally.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: These efforts represent a step in the right direction.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Not all borrowers are eligible for this program, of course; in particular, some equity is needed to qualify.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In addition, second-lien holders must settle or be willing to re-subordinate their claims for an FHA loan, which has sometimes proved difficult to negotiate.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Separately, some states have created funds to offer refinancing options, but eligibility criteria tend to be tight and the take-up rates appear to be low thus far.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In cases where refinancing is not possible, the next-best solution may often be some type of loss-mitigation arrangement between the lender and the distressed borrower.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Indeed, the Federal Reserve and other regulators have issued guidance urging lenders and servicers to pursue such arrangements as an alternative to foreclosure when feasible and prudent.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: 5 For the lender or servicer, working out a loan makes economic sense if the net present value (NPV) of the payments under a loss-mitigation strategy exceeds the NPV of payments that would be received in foreclosure.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: 6 Loss mitigation is made more attractive by the fact that foreclosure costs are often substantial.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Historically, the foreclosure process has usually taken from a few months up to a year and a half, depending on state law and whether the borrower files for bankruptcy.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The losses to the lender include the missed mortgage payments during that period, taxes, legal and administrative fees, real estate owned (REO) sales commissions, and maintenance expenses.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Additional losses arise from the reduction in value associated with repossessed properties, particularly if they are unoccupied for some period.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: A recent estimate based on subprime mortgages foreclosed in the fourth quarter of 2007 indicated that total losses exceeded 50 percent of the principal balance, with legal, sales, and maintenance expenses alone amounting to more than 10 percent of principal.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: With the time period between the last mortgage payment and REO liquidation lengthening in recent months, this loss rate will likely grow even larger.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Moreover, as the time to liquidation increases, the uncertainty about the losses increases as well.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The low prices offered for subprime-related securities in secondary markets support the impression that the potential for recovery through foreclosure is limited.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The magnitude of, and uncertainty about, expected losses in a foreclosure suggest considerable scope for negotiating a mutually beneficial outcome if the borrower wants to stay in the home.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Unfortunately, even though workouts may often be the best economic alternative, mortgage securitization and the constraints faced by servicers may make such workouts less likely.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, trusts vary in the type and scope of modifications that are explicitly permitted, and these differences raise operational compliance costs and litigation risks.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Thus, servicers may not pursue workout options that are in the collective interests of investors and borrowers.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Some progress has been made (for example, through clarification of accounting rules) in reducing the disincentive for servicers to undertake economically sensible workouts.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, the barriers to, and disincentives for, workouts by servicers remain serious problems that need to be part of current discussions about how to reduce preventable foreclosures.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: We now have more information about the recent pace of loss-mitigation activity than we did just a few months ago, thanks to surveys of servicers by the Mortgage Bankers Association, the Conference of State Bank Supervisors, the Hope Now Alliance, and others.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: These surveys generally indicate that servicers substantially increased the number of loan workouts in the latter part of last year.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Hope Now Alliance estimates that workouts of subprime mortgages rose from around 250,000 in the third quarter of 2007 to 300,000 in the fourth quarter, while workouts of prime mortgages rose from 150,000 to 175,000 over the same period.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The pace of workouts picked up a bit more in January.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Despite this progress, delinquency and default rates have risen quickly, and servicers report that they are struggling to keep up with the increased volumes.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Of course, not all delinquent subprime loans can be successfully worked out; for example, borrowers who purchased homes as speculative investments may not be interested in retaining the home, and some borrowers may not be able to sustain even a reduced stream of payments.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Nevertheless, scope remains to prevent unnecessary foreclosures.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Lenders and servicers historically have relied on repayment plans as their preferred loss-mitigation technique.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Under these plans, borrowers typically repay the mortgage arrears over a few months in addition to making their regularly scheduled mortgage payments.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: These plans are most appropriate if the borrower has suffered a potentially reversible setback, such as a job loss or illness.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, anecdotal evidence suggests that even in the best-case scenarios, borrowers given repayment plans re-default at a high rate, especially when the arrears are large.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Loan modifications, which involve any permanent change to the terms of the mortgage contract, may be preferred when the borrower cannot cope with the higher payments associated with a repayment plan.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In such cases, the monthly payment is reduced through a lower interest rate, an extension of the maturity of the loan, or a write-down of the principal balance.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The proposal by the Hope Now Alliance to freeze interest rates at the introductory rate for five years is an example of a modification, in this case applied to a class of eligible borrowers.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: To date, permanent modifications that have occurred have typically involved a reduction in the interest rate, while reductions of principal balance have been quite rare.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The preference by servicers for interest rate reductions could reflect familiarity with that technique, based on past episodes when most borrowers' problems could be solved that way.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: But the current housing difficulties differ from those in the past, largely because of the pervasiveness of negative equity positions.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: With low or negative equity, as I have mentioned, a stressed borrower has less ability (because there is no home equity to tap) and less financial incentive to try to remain in the home.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In this environment, principal reductions that restore some equity for the homeowner may be a relatively more effective means of avoiding delinquency and foreclosure.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Lenders tell us that they are reluctant to write down principal.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: They say that if they were to write down the principal and house prices were to fall further, they could feel pressured to write down principal again.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Moreover, were house prices instead to rise subsequently, the lender would not share in the gains.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In an environment of falling house prices, however, whether a reduction in the interest rate is preferable to a principal writedown is not immediately clear.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Both types of modification involve a concession of payments, are susceptible to additional pressures to write down again, and result in the same payments to the lender if the mortgage pays to maturity.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The fact that most mortgages terminate before maturity either by prepayment or default may favor an interest rate reduction.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, as I have noted, when the mortgage is "under water," a reduction in principal may increase the expected payoff by reducing the risk of default and foreclosure.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In my view, we could also reduce preventable foreclosures if investors acting in their own self interests were to permit servicers to write down the mortgage liabilities of borrowers by accepting a short payoff in appropriate circumstances.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, servicers could accept a principal writedown by an amount at least sufficient to allow the borrower to refinance into a new loan from another source.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: A writedown that is sufficient to make borrowers eligible for a new loan would remove the downside risk to investors of additional writedowns or a re-default.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: This arrangement might include a feature that allows the original investors to share in any future appreciation, as recently suggested, for example, by the Office of Thrift Supervision.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Servicers could also benefit from greater use of short payoffs, as this approach would simplify the calculation of expected losses and eliminate the future costs and risks of retaining the troubled mortgage in the pool.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: A potentially important step to facilitate greater use of short payoffs is the modernization of the FHA, which I have supported.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Going beyond the current proposals for modernization, permitting the FHA greater latitude to set underwriting standards and risk-based premiums for mortgage refinancing--in a way that does not increase the expected cost to the taxpayer--would allow the FHA to help more troubled borrowers.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: A concern about such an approach is that servicers might refinance only their riskiest borrowers into the FHA program.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: A combination of careful underwriting, the use of risk premiums, and other measures (for example, a provision that would allow the FHA to return a mortgage that quickly re-defaults to the servicer) could help mitigate that risk.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: There are, no doubt, tax-related, accounting, and legal obstacles to expanding the use of principal writedowns.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, investors in different tranches of mortgage-backed securities may not benefit equally, securitized trusts may not be permitted to acquire new equity warrants, and principal writedowns may require a different accounting treatment than interest rate reductions.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: But just as market participants, with the help of regulators, obtained greater clarity on the use of interest rate freezes through guidelines issued by the American Securitization Forum, industry and regulator efforts could also help clarify how this alternative type of workout might be effectively applied.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Federal Reserve System Efforts I would like to comment briefly on Federal Reserve System efforts to reduce preventable foreclosures and their costs on borrowers and communities.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve can help by leveraging three important strengths:  our analytical and data resources; our national presence; and our history of working closely with lenders, community groups, and other local stakeholders.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: A major thrust of our efforts is sharing relevant and timely data analysis of mortgage delinquencies with community groups and policymakers to efficiently target resources to areas most in need.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, we recently assisted NeighborWorks America in identifying regions and neighborhoods that are at risk of higher rates of foreclosure and could benefit from increased mortgage counseling capacity.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: On the basis of this analysis, NeighborWorks recently distributed $130 million in newly granted funds from Congress to thirty-two state housing finance agencies, eighty-two community-based NeighborWorks organizations, and sixteen counseling intermediaries around the country.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve System also is supporting efforts to reach troubled borrowers and to raise awareness in communities about ways to prevent foreclosures.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Since July, the community affairs groups across the Federal Reserve System have sponsored or cosponsored more than fifty events related to foreclosures, reaching more than 4,000 attendees including lenders, counselors, community development specialists, and policymakers.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: We are also concerned about the challenges of neighborhoods that have seen large increases in foreclosures and vacant properties and have begun to work with policymakers, lenders (including community banks) and community groups to address these problems.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, we have undertaken a joint effort with NeighborWorks America to help communities develop strategies for neighborhood stabilization.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Conclusion Reducing the rate of preventable foreclosures would promote economic stability for households, neighborhoods, and the nation as a whole.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Although lenders and servicers have scaled up their efforts and adopted a wider variety of loss-mitigation techniques, more can, and should, be done.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The fact that many troubled borrowers have little or no equity suggests that greater use of principal writedowns or short payoffs, perhaps with shared appreciation features, would be in the best interest of both borrowers and lenders.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: This approach would be facilitated by allowing the FHA the flexibility to offer refinancing products to more borrowers.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Ultimately, though, real relief for the mortgage market requires stabilization, and then recovery, in the nation's housing sector.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: Modernization of the FHA would be of help on this front as well.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: I am sure that the FHA and the Department of Housing and Urban Development, given the appropriate powers by the Congress, will make every effort to expand their operations and to help improve the functioning of the market for home-purchase mortgages.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: For community bankers, FHA modernization and expansion would provide an important opportunity--of which I urge you to take advantage--to better serve your customers and community.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: The government-sponsored enterprises (GSEs), Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, likewise could do a great deal to address the current problems in housing and the mortgage market.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: New capital-raising by the GSEs, together with congressional action to strengthen the supervision of these companies, would allow Fannie and Freddie to expand significantly the number of new mortgages that they securitize.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: With few alternative mortgage channels available today, such action would be highly beneficial to the economy.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida

speaker: Bernanke
text: I urge the Congress and the GSEs to take the steps necessary to allow more potential homebuyers access to mortgage credit at reasonable terms.
speech_title: Reducing Preventable Mortgage Foreclosures
speech_venue: At the Independent Community Bankers of America Annual Convention, Orlando, Florida
