speaker: Mishkin
text: A decade later, inflation has remained within 1 percentage point of the target in all but a single month, or less than 1 percent of the time.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: See the empirical analysis and discussion of Fatás, Mihov, and Rose (2007) and Mishkin and Schmidt-Hebbel (2001, 2007).
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: I will spare the audience a thorough discussion of the methodological issues involved in the measurement of inflation expectations.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: Some recent work on the topic was presented at the Conference on Price Measurement for Monetary Policy, hosted by the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas on May 24-25, 2007.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: See Castelnuovo, Altimari, and Rodriguez-Palenzuela (2003); Levin, Natalucci, and Piger (2004); and Gürkaynak, Levin, and Swanson (2006).
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: There is also some evidence that the dispersion of inflation expectations may decrease with adoption of explicit inflation objectives.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: Mankiw, Reis, and Wolfers (2003) have shown that simple survey statistics, such as the mean or median inflation expectations, can sometimes hide substantial cross-sectional dispersion in survey responses.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: If a central bank's credibility in meeting the inflation objective truly increases over time, one should then observe less disagreement among inflation forecasters.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: The international evidence on this aspect is unfortunately scant due to limited data availability.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: Beechey, Johannsen, and Levin (2007) recently showed that the cross-sectional dispersion of long-run inflation expectations in the European Central Bank (ECB) Survey of Professional Forecasters, as measured by the standard deviation, has more than halved since the ECB, with its explicit inflation objectives, was launched in 1999.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Mishkin
text: Although this evidence cannot be used directly to measure the impact that the adoption of an explicit inflation objective has on the dispersion of inflation expectations, it nevertheless suggests that there are additional benefits to increasing a central bankâs credibility.
speech_title: Central Bank Commitment and Communication
speech_venue: At the Princeton University Center for Economic Policy Studies Dinner, New York, New York

speaker: Kroszner
text: Strains in global financial markets first became manifest last summer, when sharply rising delinquency rates on subprime mortgages in the United States caused investors to become concerned about the credit quality of home mortgages more broadly and about the exposures of major financial institutions to credit losses.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These strains have persisted and, indeed, spread during the winter.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In the United States, the continued poor functioning of securitization markets, particularly those for private mortgage-backed securities and other structured finance products, as well as pressures on balance sheet capacity at some large banks and a deterioration in loan performance, have led to tighter credit conditions for many households and businesses.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The tightening of credit, along with information suggesting that the housing correction was likely to be deeper and more prolonged than initially thought and that the labor market was weakening, led many analysts to revise down their outlook for economic activity.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In turn, the deterioration in the economic outlook seems to have fed back into financial markets, contributing to lower prices for a range of securities and to trading conditions that are more volatile and less liquid.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Aspects of the U.S. experience have also been felt in other advanced economies, although generally to a lesser degree.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The origination of mortgages to borrowers with less-than-prime credit profiles fell sharply over the second half of last year in the United States, and this segment of the market has continued to function poorly.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, the origination of jumbo mortgages to prime-rated homeowners has fallen since last summer, as lenders tightened their underwriting standards and raised the cost of those loans.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In contrast, mortgages that qualify for backing by the housing government-sponsored enterprises continue to be readily available to households.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: For other types of consumer credit, such as auto loans and credit cards, access has diminished somewhat in recent months as lending standards have been tightened and securitization of consumer loans has become more difficult.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In corporate markets, highly rated firms have continued to issue a sizable volume of bonds, but issuance of speculative-grade debt has been sluggish recently.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In the leveraged loan market, banks have found it difficult to syndicate loans previously underwritten to finance large leveraged buyout deals, and the still-large pipeline of leveraged loans has led to an unplanned expansion of some large banks' balance sheets.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, some banks have taken onto their balance sheets assets for which they provided liquidity backstops or other forms of support.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These balance sheet pressures have come at a time when asset write-downs were already weighing on capital.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: As I will discuss later, this episode underscores the important connection for banks between capital adequacy and liquidity, particularly in times of financial market stress.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Despite the adverse developments in recent months, large U.S. banking organizations, in the aggregate and individually, have maintained capital ratios in excess of regulatory requirements, in part because of steps taken by many to replenish equity positions.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Indeed, since last fall, large U.S. bank holding companies have raised more than $50 billion in capital.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Although the U.S. banking system will continue to face a challenging environment, it remains in sound overall condition, having entered the period of recent financial turmoil with solid capital and strong earnings.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Federal Reserve Actions To improve market liquidity and market functioning, and consistent with its role as the nation's central bank, the Federal Reserve has supplemented its longstanding discount window by establishing new facilities to depository institutions and primary dealers.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The first of these actions was initiated in August, when the Federal Reserve modified the terms for borrowing from the discount window.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Then, in December, the Fed introduced a term lending facility that provided funding to depository institutions without the potential stigma of discount window borrowing.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: At the same time, the Federal Reserve, in conjunction with other central banks, established reciprocal currency swap arrangements to provide dollars to address elevated pressures in foreign interbank funding markets.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Last month, the Fed announced a series of initiatives to address additional stresses that emerged more recently.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Taken as a group, these actions have had a threefold purpose: to expand the range of institutions with access to collateralized loans from the Federal Reserve, to broaden the types of securities that can be pledged as collateral, and to lengthen the terms of the loans obtained from the Fed.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: To date, these liquidity measures seem to have been helpful, as funding pressures on some financial institutions appear to have eased somewhat and as liquidity seems to have improved in several financial markets.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: To the extent that these measures improve market functioning, they will have favorable effects on the availability of credit to the broader economy.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: More-liquid markets also increase the efficacy of monetary policy.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In response to the weakening of economic conditions, the Federal Reserve has eased the stance of monetary policy substantially.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Open Market Committee last month lowered the target for the federal funds rate to 2-1/4 percent--3 percentage points below its level last summer.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Committee anticipates that these actions, together with the steps we have taken to foster market liquidity, will help to promote growth over time and to mitigate the risks to economic activity.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The remainder of my remarks this morning will cover the implications of these financial market strains for Latin America, focusing on the linkages between the U.S. and Latin economies and how they have evolved over time.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Although there have been major structural improvements in Latin American economies, the region is also benefiting from favorable global conditions that are helping to offset potential adverse spillovers from the financial strains.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Nevertheless, those strains highlight some challenges going forward in Latin America, particularly in the area of the regulation of financial institutions.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: This is no time for policymakers anywhere to feel complacent.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Developments in Latin America The recent financial turbulence has been evident in Latin America, but not as strongly as in the United States and Europe.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Spreads on Latin American dollar-denominated sovereign bonds over U.S. Treasury securities are up noticeably since early last year, but they remain low from a historical perspective.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In the relatively new Latin markets for long-term local-currency bonds, yields have edged up in a few countries but have remained essentially flat in others.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Equity prices in Latin America are down relatively little compared with their very large increases in 2006 and early 2007.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The pace of economic growth has edged down in many (but not all) Latin countries from high rates in 2006 and early 2007.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The latest International Monetary Fund (IMF) forecast, however, continues to project solid rates of growth this year and next in most Latin American countries.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: With a few notable exceptions, inflation has remained relatively well under control; in most countries, rising commodity prices have led to only modest increases in headline inflation rates.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In light of the recent indications of a weakening U.S. economy, is there any historical precedent for Latin America to avoid spillovers?
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In the past, U.S. slowdowns have typically been associated with slowdowns in Latin America.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Indeed, often the slowdowns in Latin America were much sharper than in the United States.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: One of the most famous examples of this effect occurred during the U.S. economic downturn of the early 1980s, which was associated with high U.S. interest rates.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The increased pressures on financing flows and the reduced demand for exports contributed to widespread slowdowns in Latin American economies that in many cases were more severe than the U.S. slowdown.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: A milder version of such a synchronized slowdown occurred in 2001.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: There have been exceptions to this pattern, however.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: For example, many Latin countries experienced solid expansions during the U.S. contraction of 1990-91.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: A variety of factors, some unique to individual countries, contributed to this good outcome.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Perhaps most notable was the launch of the Brady Plan in 1989 to restructure the sovereign external debts of a number of developing countries.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: This restructuring, along with previous fiscal and financial sector reforms in the wake of the debt crisis of the early 1980s, encouraged renewed capital flows to much of Latin America just around the time that the U.S. economy was slowing down.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Linkages between the United States and Latin America To better assess the prospects and lessons for Latin America from the recent financial strains, it may be useful to review the various linkages between the two regions.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These linkages include trade flows, capital flows of various types, and shared global shocks such as the recent run-ups in commodity prices.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Trade has been growing faster than the gross domestic product in many Latin economies.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: An economic slowdown in a key trading partner generally reduces demand for a country's exports, putting downward pressure on overall activity.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: However, with the exception of Mexico, most Latin American countries are not particularly exposed to U.S. demand for their exports.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: A more important linkage for many Latin American countries has been capital flows from the United States and other advanced economies.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Differences in the environment for capital flows, for example, appeared to be a key factor behind the much better outcome in 1990-91 compared with 1981-83.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Bank lending to Latin America has not regained the leading role it held in the 1970s, but it has grown significantly in recent years after a long period of quiescence.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Local-currency bond markets are an important recent development that is attracting some interest from foreign investors, but so far, most of the local-currency issues have been purchased by local investors such as pension funds.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: 1 Foreign capital has surged into Latin American equity markets in recent years, helping to push market capitalizations to new heights.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Finally, foreign direct investment into Latin America is substantial and has continued to grow.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The IMF estimates that total private capital inflows to Latin America jumped to $173 billion last year, compared with an average of $79 billion per year over the previous ten years.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: 2 An important factor fostering these flows has been improvements in macroeconomic and microeconomic policies.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: An interesting and potentially important development in the past five to ten years has been the decline of current account deficits throughout Latin America and the rise of current account surpluses in many countries in the region.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: External debt burdens also have fallen substantially.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In part, these developments reflect greatly improved fiscal discipline.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Whereas bond issuance in international markets was an important source of capital in the 1990s, the improving fiscal situation led to negative net international bond issuance for Latin America, on balance, during much of the current decade.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Indeed, Brazil recently announced that its foreign assets exceeded its foreign liabilities for the first time ever, reflecting increases in international reserves, buybacks of global bonds, and the retirement of its IMF loans.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Large holdings of foreign exchange reserves provide a valuable cushion against fluctuations in foreign demand for a nation's exports or financial assets.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: It is important, however, to recognize that the decline of net capital flows to Latin America has not been accompanied by an equivalent decline in gross flows.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Indeed, globalization has led to increasing gross holdings of both assets and liabilities with the rest of the world.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Thus, to a great extent, all countries have become linked by a common global market for capital in a way that we have never seen before.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Global shocks constitute a third set of linkages between the United States and Latin America.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The recent global increases in commodity prices have generally had negative implications for U.S. growth and positive implications for Latin American growth, as the United States is a net commodity importer and Latin America is a net commodity exporter.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: High commodity prices have also encouraged foreign investment, and thus capital flows, to help develop the commodity resources of Latin America.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Of course, commodity prices themselves are influenced by global economic activity; a U.S. slowdown could put downward pressure on commodity prices, providing an indirect but potentially significant link between the two regions.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Inter-American Development Bank background paper for this session argues forcefully that recent strong global growth and high commodity prices provide a very supportive environment for Latin American economies.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: 3 These developments have helped to mitigate the effects on Latin America of financial market strains and the slowdown in U.S. economic activity.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: It is important not to lose sight of the fact that linkages through trade and capital flows continue to be important and, indeed, have even increased over the past decade or so.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Lessons Going Forward What are the lessons that Latin America should draw from the recent financial strains in light of the growing linkages between Latin America and the rest of the world?
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: I think it is extremely important to bolster the great progress that has been made in many countries in the framework of macroeconomic and microeconomic policies and to extend these improvements to those countries that have experienced little improvement so far.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The current attractive conditions for commodity exporters should not deceive us into thinking that Latin America has permanently escaped international business cycles.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: On the macro front, the good economic outcomes in most of Latin America that I described earlier reflect greater discipline in both monetary and fiscal policy.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Although there have been some exceptions, central banks in Latin America have demonstrated their resolve to prevent inflation pressures from becoming entrenched.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Governments generally have not allowed spending to absorb all of the increased fiscal revenue from rapid growth.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In terms of microeconomics, bank regulation has been strengthened, and local equity and bond markets have been developed and are growing in a number of Latin American countries.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Financial fragility from currency and maturity mismatches in the structure of debt has been pared back.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Together, these structural improvements reduce the vulnerability of the financial system to external and internal shocks.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Not only do better macro policy frameworks help to strengthen local financial systems, but they provide confidence to investors that prudent policies will be taken in the face of external shocks.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Better microeconomic regulatory policies help markets to operate more efficiently, thereby increasing economic growth, which makes continued monetary and fiscal discipline easier to achieve.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Continuing this virtuous circle should be a priority.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The recent financial strains and the potential for spillovers to Latin America only heighten the need for policymakers in the region to avoid complacency.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Among potential microeconomic improvements, developing markets for residential mortgage securities is obviously an important priority for Latin American countries going forward.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Key elements of such markets in any country are solid underwriting standards, meaningful credit disclosure policies, and strong protections for consumers from abusive and deceptive practices.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Toward that end, in the United States, the Federal Reserve has recently proposed stricter regulations for mortgage lenders to protect consumers from abusive practices while maintaining the viability of a market for responsible mortgage lending.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The proposed rules would tighten standards on higher-priced mortgage loans, which we have defined broadly so as to cover substantially all of the subprime market.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The proposed rules also cover a range of practices.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: For example, the rules would prohibit a lender from engaging in a pattern or practice of making higher-priced loans that borrowers cannot reasonably be expected to repay from income or from assets other than the house.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Lenders also would be required to verify the income or assets on which they rely to make credit decisions for higher-priced loans.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve is also working to improve mortgage disclosures through consumer testing so they are more effective.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: These rules are particularly valuable for households that have little experience with homeownership and short credit histories.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Careful underwriting standards and good transparency for borrowers are important building blocks for a healthy market in mortgage-backed securities, which can help to foster the flow of credit to the housing sector in Latin America.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Risk Management around the Globe Sound banking regulations are another high priority for Latin America and the rest of the world.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In particular, I'd like to emphasize how recent market events underscore that financial institutions around the globe face important risk management challenges.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: One of the most basic risk-management challenges relates to concentration of risk.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: As banks have extended their range of activities and involvement in new markets, including the markets for securitized assets, they must, for a number of reasons, be particularly mindful of the potential for concentrations of risk to arise.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: First, there is simply less information available to evaluate risks on new activities.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Second, risk concentrations can be hidden during normal times and may manifest themselves only during times of stress, such as the recent marketwide increase in the demand for liquidity.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Third, there is an important linkage between risk concentrations and capital: The concentration of risk of a given portfolio markedly affects the amount of capital that should be held against it.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: I would like to elaborate on these themes by briefly describing how they can be used to improve the practice of risk management in three fundamental areas: risk identification and measurement, liquidity risk management, and governance and risk control.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Risk Identification and Measurement The first fundamental of sound risk management relates to risk identification and measurement.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Timely and accurate information is the lifeblood of sound risk management.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: A good risk-management structure is designed to identify the full spectrum of risks across the entire firm, gathering and processing information on an enterprisewide basis in real time.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In short, you cannot manage your risks if you do not know what they are.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Gathering information should be done with appropriate care and with adequate resources for checking timeliness and veracity.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Risk managers should live by the adage, "Trust but verify," being careful not to rely on assessments or data from others without conducting proper due diligence.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: It is also worth noting that financial institutions should gather information before they see market troubles brewing.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In other words, scrambling for information once turbulence sets in is not a good practice.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Thus, even if Latin America has not experienced the strains that other markets are experiencing, it is nonetheless important to be proactive about stress testing and scenario analysis.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Understanding a firm's true risk exposures requires examining not just risks on the balance sheet, but also off-balance-sheet risks that are sometimes more difficult to identify and often not so easy to quantify.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Latent risks from certain complex products and certain risky activities are particularly problematic, because they can manifest themselves when market turbulence sets in.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Careful analysis is particularly important for new financial products that have not been fully "road-tested"; this caveat also applies when products with a track record in one country are introduced to another country for the first time or markets develop rapidly in a country.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Stress testing and scenario analysis are essential tools in the analysis of risk, because they can reveal potential concentrations of risk that may not be apparent when using information gleaned from normal times.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Liquidity Risk Management Next, I wish to consider the second fundamental, liquidity risk management.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Because of its central role in the business of banking, liquidity risk requires rigorous and effective management.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: This is a fundamental truth that may have even greater relevance in Latin American markets, where securities tend to be less liquid than in the United States and where banks rarely have the luxury of selling their loans.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Recent events have shown that during times of systemwide stress, liquidity shocks can become correlated so that the same factors that can lead to liquidity problems for the bank's assets or off-balance-sheet vehicles can simultaneously put pressure on a bank's own funding liquidity.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Again, we see the trouble that risk concentrations can cause if an institution has not tried to identify them in advance and has not taken steps to mitigate their effects.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: As I mentioned earlier, we also have noticed the potential for liquidity risk to have an impact on capital adequacy.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In a few cases, unplanned increases in a bank's balance sheet led some banks to take measures to bolster their capital.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Because risk concentrations have the potential to manifest themselves during times of stress and at that time adversely affect capital positions, it is particularly important that firms assess how liquidity events could place pressure on capital levels.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In a nutshell, liquidity problems always have the potential to affect bank balance sheets and, in doing so, bank capital adequacy.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Governance and Risk Control The third fundamental, governance and risk control, has been a key factor that differentiated performance across financial institutions during recent events.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: 4 Clearly, senior management of financial institutions must take on a very active and involved role in risk management.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: In some cases, it appears that managers were not fully aware of the extent to which the risks of the different activities undertaken by the firm could, first, become correlated in times of stress and, second, result in high concentrations of risk exposures.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: For example, those in senior management may not have been cognizant of a firm's overall concentration to U.S. subprime mortgages, because they did not realize that in addition to the subprime mortgages on their books, they had exposure through off-balance-sheet vehicles holding such mortgages, through claims on counterparties exposed to subprime, and through certain complex securities.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Senior managers should encourage risk managers to dig deep to uncover not only risks within each business unit, but also risk concentrations that can arise from the set of activities undertaken by the firm as a whole as well as latent risks--such as hidden risk concentrations that can arise from correlation of risk in times of stress.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: It can be very difficult to challenge one's colleagues by pointing out business activities that may be creating too much risk, and that is why it is crucial for the risk manager to be known both inside and outside the firm as an independent voice who is influential with top management.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Executives also must set the appropriate tone at the top with respect to the importance of independent and unbiased risk evaluation.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Conclusion While improvements in both macroeconomic and microeconomic policies have helped to make some Latin American countries less vulnerable to outside shocks, the region is not decoupled from the United States and the rest of the world.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: As globalization has proceeded, Latin America is increasingly connected to the world through global capital flows and capital markets.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: Further improvements in both macroeconomic and microeconomic policies are imperative to maintain those flows and economic health, particularly in the face of global financial turbulence.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kroszner
text: One area that merits particular attention is enhancing the management of risk in financial institutions and markets in Latin America as well as emerging markets more generally.
speech_title: Global Economic and Financial Challenges: Implications for Latin America
speech_venue: At the Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Inter-American Development Bank, Miami, Florida

speaker: Kohn
text: It is my honor and pleasure to be here today to help dedicate the new Seattle Branch building, and to speak about how this terrific new facility will assist the Federal Reserve System's efforts to help guide the national economy and serve the payment needs of the Northwest.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: I would like to express my personal appreciation to the City of Renton for its support and assistance in locating the Seattle Branch at its new home along Naches Avenue.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: As Chairman of the Committee on Federal Reserve Bank Affairs at the Board of Governors, I have followed this building project closely, and value the city's cooperation in helping ensure its future success.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: I especially appreciate the city's close cooperation with us in upgrading the utilities and streets serving the site and, essentially, making it a welcome new home for Branch employees.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: The Seattle Branch, created in 1917, was housed in leased space until a downtown site was built in 1950.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: Although that building served the Seattle area's needs well for more than fifty years, service demands on the Branch have evolved and outstripped the capabilities of the old building and site.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: The vault and cash processing areas were no longer adequate for efficient operations, and cash delivery facilities could not accommodate the type and number of delivery vehicles, which had resulted in armored trucks queued along Spring Street.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: Furthermore, the building's general layout and construction did not meet the post-9/11 security requirements necessary for protecting Federal Reserve System employees and operations.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: We considered several sites in the Seattle metropolitan area for the new building, initially searching for a suitable site within the city limits.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: But our site and transportation requirements prompted us to consider options within the broader metropolitan area, and we found that this location's proximity to major roads and highways will improve vehicular access for employees, visitors, and delivery personnel.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: As you may have noticed, the new site is large--almost 10 acres--and its security is evident.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: Clearly, the safety of our employees and operations is a high priority that has become a greater focus in the post-9/11 era, but the building is more than just secure: Its design supports our mission, which is to promote a stable and efficient financial system and to conduct a monetary policy that fosters maximum employment and stable prices.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: In recognition of our responsibilities as a community partner, the architecture of the building reflects both the character of the area as well as environmental concerns.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: For example, the building site borders a wetlands area that the Bank was careful to consider in situating the structure and tailoring the landscaping.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: A construction objective was to minimize the project's cost by using materials and methods commonly employed locally.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: The new building's exterior is a combination of low-maintenance glass, metal, and concrete elements.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: In all, the designers have produced a handsome design that reflects the Branch's desired utilitarian theme and functional requirements.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: The natural landscaping around the building reflects the character of the region as well, and it serves as an important feature in the overall design, and helps minimize ongoing maintenance costs.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: And besides serving as an attractive asset in the City of Renton and in the greater Seattle metropolitan area, the new building should act as a catalyst for further development of the Longacres area by attracting other financial services facilities.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: It will serve as an ideal location for meetings with the Branch board of directors and as a facility for interacting with a wider public audience to exchange information on economic developments in the Northwest.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: And these meetings will support our broader monetary policy mission.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: Monetary policy is directed by the Federal Open Market Committee, or FOMC, which consists of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and the Reserve Bank presidents.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: The FOMC relies on information provided by business people and others and economic intelligence gathered from around the nation.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: The Seattle Branch assists FOMC policymakers by monitoring indicators of economic conditions at the grassroots level here in the Northwest through liaison with local community groups and businesses.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: In addition, through community outreach, the Seattle Branch supports the Federal Reserve's aim to provide economic information to the community and offer economic and financial education programs to local groups and schools.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: Maintaining the effectiveness of the nation's payment system is another important aspect of our work here in the Northwest.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: The distribution of currency is critical to the local economy, and the Federal Reserve has the responsibility to ensure the reliability and availability of cash.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: Fortunately, the new Branch building is designed to meet the cash service of Seattle area residents for many years to come.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: It comes equipped with state-of-the-art cash handling systems, including an automated storage vault to further improve operational efficiency, and its currency operations are designed to be scalable to address changing demands for cash in the Seattle region.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: Let me conclude by reiterating my great pleasure in participating in this ceremony, which underscores our commitment to serve the growing needs of the Seattle and greater Northwest communities.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

text: I appreciate the opportunity you've provided me to speak about our central bank roles and functions and our strong links with the local economic community.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Kohn
text: I am confident that this building will enable us to continue to meet our own mission objectives and serve as an integral member of the community for many years to come.
speech_title: Dedication remarks
speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

text: I congratulate Branch staff and the community for their roles in ushering in this outstanding facility.
