speech_venue: At the Dedication of the New Seattle Branch Building of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Renton, Washington

speaker: Bernanke
text: The financial preparedness of our nation's youth is essential to their well-being and of vital importance to our economic future.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: In light of the problems that have arisen in the subprime mortgage market, we are reminded of how critically important it is for individuals to become financially literate at an early age so that they are better prepared to make decisions and navigate an increasingly complex financial marketplace.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: Choosing a credit card, saving for retirement or for a child's education, or buying a home now requires more financial savvy than ever before.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: Financial literacy and consumer education--coupled with robust consumer protection--makes the financial marketplace effective and efficient, and better equips consumers to make tough yet smart financial decisions.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: Today, only eight states across the U.S. require personal finance before middle or high school graduation.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: I believe more states should consider making personal finance a requirement for all students who seek a high school diploma.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: I am personally convinced that improving education is vital to the future of our economy and all its citizens, and I strongly believe that promoting financial literacy, in particular, must be a high priority.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: I know that those of you here today join me in this conviction.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Jump$tart Coalition is a leader among organizations seeking to improve the personal financial literacy of students from kindergarten to the university level.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, through its biennial survey of high school seniors--the results of which you will hear about shortly--Jump$tart has brought increased attention to the need for greater financial literacy among the youth of our nation.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: During the Jump$tart survey's 12-year history, the data gathered have served as the basis for useful measures of what young adults do and don't understand about finances.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: Undoubtedly, we will soon learn that there is plenty of work to be done and that our students have much to learn.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve is strongly committed to Jump$tart's mission to better educate America's youth about personal finance.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: On the regional level, many Federal Reserve Banks work closely with the state coalitions to help achieve this worthy mission.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: In fact, there is at least one economic education specialist at each of the Reserve Banks and their branches.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: Many of these specialists offer training seminars to help educators teach vital economic and personal finance topics in their classrooms.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve also continues to support a variety of programs and initiatives to increase financial literacy.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: In addition to these and many other Federal Reserve resources, we will continue to work to expand the resources and programs devoted to the important public policy challenge of improving financial literacy.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: I want to take this opportunity to thank the Jump$tart Coalition and their partners for their continued support and commitment to furthering the financial education of our youth.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: Now, it is with great pleasure that I introduce Laura Levine, executive director of Jump$tart and appointed member of President Bush's recently formed Council on Financial Literacy, who will give a report on the status of financial education of youth in this country.
speech_title: The Importance of Financial Education and the National Jump$tart Coalition Survey
speech_venue: At the Jump$tart Coalition for Personal Financial Literacy and Federal Reserve Board Joint News Conference, Federal Reserve Board, Washington, D.C.

speaker: Bernanke
text: Even as we have worked to resolve the current crisis, however, the Federal Reserve has also been part of a national and international effort to draw at least some preliminary conclusions about the sources of the current turmoil as well as the implications for public policy.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In my remarks today I will discuss some of these conclusions and, in the process, identify some measures that should be taken to strengthen the global financial system in light of the recent experience.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the United States, policymakers' efforts to identify the sources of the financial turmoil and the appropriate public- and private-sector responses have been coordinated through the President's Working Group on Financial Markets (PWG), chaired by the Secretary of the Treasury.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The group's other principals include the heads of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, and the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: With the support of the staff of the respective agencies, the PWG began to address these issues last fall, as the severity of the financial turmoil became increasingly apparent; in mid-March, we issued a brief statement outlining our tentative conclusions and policy recommendations.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: 1 At the international level, the Financial Stability Forum (FSF), whose membership consists of central bankers, regulators, and finance ministers from many countries, including the United States, will also soon release a report on the causes of and potential responses to the turmoil.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: I describe these policy development processes to underscore the cooperative nature of the enterprise, both among the U.S. authorities and between the United States and other countries.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Given the global nature of our financial markets and institutions, international cooperation is essential to making the regulatory and supervisory structure more effective.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As I will discuss, many of our recommendations involve actions to be taken by market participants, and so their buy-in and cooperation is essential as well.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We have consulted extensively with market participants on these issues and will continue to do so.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As you may know, the Department of the Treasury recently issued a blueprint for regulatory reform in the United States.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The focus of the Treasury's work is on the appropriate design principles for our regulatory system--including the system's structure and governance, the appropriate scope of regulators' responsibilities, and how those responsibilities should be allocated across agencies--rather than on the specific issues raised by the current crisis.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Given its focus on fundamental reform, the recommendations of the Treasury blueprint are mostly intended to be undertaken in the longer term.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In that respect, it is an important first step, and we look forward to working with the Congress and others in developing a framework that modernizes our financial and regulatory architecture.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The analysis of the PWG that I will be discussing today is more sharply focused on recent events, and its recommendations are intended to be part of the near-term and medium-term effort to restore more normal functioning of financial markets and to improve the operation of the current system.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Diagnosis Let me begin with the diagnosis of the causes of the crisis, focusing primarily on the U.S. case and the conclusions drawn by the PWG.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Although many factors played a role, to a considerable extent the current problems arose in the implementation of the so-called originate-to-distribute approach to credit extension.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The originate-to-distribute model breaks down the process of credit extension, from origination to the ultimate financing, into component parts, or stages, in a manner reminiscent of how contemporary manufacturers distribute the stages of production across firms and locations.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: This approach has had considerable benefits, including increased access of small and medium-sized borrowers to the broader capital markets, but pitfalls in its implementation are now evident.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To describe how the originate-to-distribute model works, let's consider a simplified description of how a mortgage loan is made and financed within this framework.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the first stage of the process, the originator--a lender or a broker serving as a lender's agent--extends the mortgage loan to a potential homebuyer.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The originator is responsible for the underwriting--that is, for ensuring that the borrower is creditworthy and that the terms of the mortgage appropriately reflect the risks of the transaction.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the next stage, the originator sells the mortgage to another financial institution, let's call it the packager, which combines the mortgage with many other loans to create a marketable security.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: (This process usually involves the creation of a separate legal vehicle, which holds the underlying mortgages or other assets and issues claims against itself.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: I will skip the technical details here.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Sometimes the originator and what I have called the packager are the same institution.)
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The most straightforward case involves combining the mortgage with other mortgages to create a mortgage-backed security (MBS); the owner (or owners) of an MBS has claims on the cash flows arising from the underlying mortgages.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: MBS are familiar financial instruments; indeed, the government-sponsored enterprises Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac have been creating and selling MBS for a long time, as have a number of other financial institutions.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, much more complex securities can also be created, backed for example by a mix of different types of loans or other assets combined with various guarantees or hedges; in recent years the issuance of these so-called structured credit products increased sharply.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Importantly, the newly created securities may be broken into pieces, or tranches, of varying seniority and credit quality.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the third stage of the originate-to-distribute process, these tranches are rated separately by one or more credit rating agencies, then sold to investors with differing preferences for risk or retained by the lender.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In principle, the originate-to-distribute model spreads risk and reduces financing costs while affording borrowers greater access to capital.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In practice, however, problems arose in recent years throughout the originate-to-distribute chain, resulting ultimately in a broad retreat from this model late last summer.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: First, at the point of origination, underwriting standards became increasingly compromised.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The best-known and most serious case is that of subprime mortgages, mortgages extended to borrowers with weaker credit histories.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To a degree that increased over time, these mortgages were often poorly documented and extended with insufficient attention to the borrower's ability to repay.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In retrospect, the breakdown in underwriting can be linked to the incentives that the originate-to-distribute model, as implemented in this case, created for the originators.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Notably, the incentive structures often tied originator revenue to loan volume, rather than to the quality of the loans being passed up the chain.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Investors normally have the right to put loans that default quickly back to the originator, which should tend to apply some discipline to the underwriting process.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, in the recent episode, some originators had little capital at stake, reducing their exposure to the risk that the loans would perform poorly.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: So long as house prices were rising, subprime borrowers saw their home equity increase and were often able to refinance into more-sustainable mortgages.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, when house prices began to fall, borrowers' refinancing options disappeared and the problems with subprime mortgage underwriting were exposed.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Delinquency rates soared, particularly on subprime mortgages with adjustable rates.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Because subprime mortgages were frequently securitized, often as part of complex structured credit products, the losses associated with these delinquencies spread throughout the system.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Although subprime mortgages were the most obvious example, the loosening of credit standards and terms occurred more broadly, reflecting a general boom in credit markets that peaked and then reversed last summer.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: This boom was characterized by a general erosion of market discipline, underpricing of risk, and insufficient attention by investors to the quality or riskiness of the instruments they purchased.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, in the market for so-called leveraged loans, used to finance mergers or buyouts, investors showed themselves willing to purchase debt with few covenants or other protections.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The PWG also concluded that investors often took insufficient care in evaluating the risks of structured credit products, in part because they over-relied on the evaluations provided by the credit rating agencies.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Unfortunately, the methodologies and assumptions the agencies used to rate many credit products proved faulty, and their data were inadequate (in part because of the lack of extensive experience with these products).
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: When rising delinquencies and losses on mortgages forced the agencies to sharply downgrade many structured credit products, investors lost confidence in those ratings and became unwilling to provide new funds.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As financing disappeared, the markets for these products and for related investments, such as asset-backed commercial paper, seized up.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Another factor that the PWG identified as contributing to the financial turmoil was weakness in the risk-management practices of large global financial institutions that created and held complex credit products.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As demonstrated by comparative studies of institutions' performance, which we at the Federal Reserve conducted in concert with regulators both in the United States and abroad, some firms fell short in identifying and managing the risks they were taking.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, some firms had not developed adequate capacity to measure their aggregate exposures to subprime credit risk across business lines, leaving them vulnerable to significant losses at the level of the entire firm.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Thus, the spreading of risk that was one of the supposed benefits of the originate-to-distribute model proved to be much less extensive than many believed.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The pullback of investors from structured credit products also imposed significant liquidity pressures on many of the largest financial institutions, which were left scrambling to fund instruments they could not sell or to meet contingent funding obligations for which they had not adequately planned.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: These weaknesses were particularly evident with respect to managing risks from exposures related to collateralized debt obligations, off-balance-sheet conduits that issued asset-backed commercial paper, and leveraged loan syndications.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The combination of unanticipated losses, which reduced capital, and severe liquidity pressures has significantly reduced the ability and willingness of some large financial institutions to extend fresh credit or to make markets, with adverse effects for the broader markets and for the economy.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The originate-to-distribute model thus broke down at a number of key points, including at the stages of underwriting, credit rating, and investor due diligence.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Financial institutions were caught, in some cases, by inadequate risk management and liquidity planning.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: These problems notwithstanding, the originate-to-distribute model has proven effective in the past and with adequate repairs could be so again in the future.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Recommendations The PWG's recommendations flow logically from the problems that we identified.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: First, the weaknesses in the origination stage of the originate-to-distribute model must be corrected; no matter how elaborate and sophisticated, credit instruments can be no stronger than the underwriting that supports them.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Market participants will not easily forget the lessons of the recent period, and so market discipline will help in this respect.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: I expect that, in the future, investors will be eager to ensure that their own interests and those of the originators are better aligned, which should lead to more conservative and careful underwriting.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: But better consumer protections and disclosures, as well as greater supervisory scrutiny of the processes that originators follow and the incentives they face, are also needed.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the mortgage area, the PWG recommended action at both the federal and state levels, including, for example, stronger nationwide licensing standards for mortgage brokers and more consistent government oversight for all originators.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, the PWG recommended that the Federal Reserve use its authority to strengthen consumer protection rules and enhance required disclosures for mortgage originations.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: I strongly support this recommendation, and its implementation is well under way.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Specifically, the Federal Reserve has used its authority under the Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act to propose and seek comment on new rules that, for higher-cost loans, would strengthen consumer protections.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The rules would restrict the use of prepayment penalties and low-documentation lending, require the use of escrow accounts for property taxes and homeowner's insurance, and ensure that lenders give sufficient consideration to borrowers' ability to repay.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In addition, for all mortgage loans, we have proposed rules regarding broker compensation methods and the ability of appraisers to provide judgments free of undue influence, as well as rules regarding the accuracy of advertisements and solicitations for mortgage loans and the timeliness of required disclosures.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We also plan to propose a revised set of required mortgage disclosures based on the results of a program of consumer testing already under way.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We will monitor the effectiveness of the new rules and take additional steps as necessary.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To strengthen enforcement, we have initiated a pilot program to improve the coordination among federal and state authorities in the examination of nonbank mortgage lenders.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Another problem identified by the PWG was the inadequate care by investors in their evaluations of securitized credits, particularly the more complex structured securitizations.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: More transparency about the risks and other characteristics of securitized credits on the part of their sponsors would obviously help.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: But more generally, investors must take responsibility for developing independent views of the risks of these instruments and not rely solely on credit ratings.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Some investors, such as public pension funds, are subject to government oversight, and in these instances, the PWG will look to their government overseers to reinforce implementation of stronger due diligence practices.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: When investors employ advisers, the mandates and incentives given to these advisers should be structured so as to induce a more careful and nuanced evaluation of the risks and returns of alternative products.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Improving the performance of the credit rating agencies is another key priority.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As I mentioned, analytical weaknesses and inadequate data underlay many of the problems in the ratings of structured finance products.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Beyond improving their methods, however, the credit rating agencies would serve investors better by providing greater transparency.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Credit rating agencies should, for example, publish sufficient information about the assumptions underlying their rating methodologies and models so that users can understand how a particular rating was determined.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: It is also important for the credit rating agencies to clarify that a given rating applied to a structured credit product may have a different meaning than the same rating applied to a corporate bond or a municipal security.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Indeed, some have suggested that the agencies use different rating nomenclatures for different types of products.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Transparency about methods should also help to reduce concerns about conflicts of interest that might arise from the fact that issuers of securities pay the rating agencies for their work in rating those securities.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The credit rating agencies themselves clearly appreciate that concerns about the quality of ratings and potential conflicts of interest represent a fundamental challenge to their business model, and they have begun to address these issues.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The SEC, which has regulatory responsibility for the credit rating agencies, is conducting a broad review of issues regarding potential conflicts of interest at the rating agencies and is likely to identify further measures that should be implemented.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As I noted earlier, the turmoil in financial markets has also revealed significant weaknesses in the risk-management practices of some large, globally active financial institutions; these weaknesses have exacerbated the problems in the markets by compromising the abilities of these key firms to absorb risk and serve as intermediaries.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Prudential supervisors in the affected financial markets began joint work late last summer to identify common deficiencies on which they and the firms should focus.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The supervisors concluded that the firms that suffered the most significant losses tended to exhibit common problems, including insufficiently close monitoring of off-balance-sheet exposures, inadequate attention to the implications for the firm as a whole of risks taken in individual business lines, dependence on a narrow range of risk measures, deficiencies in liquidity planning, and inadequate attention to valuation issues.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To be sure, firms varied in the degree to which they were subject to these weaknesses, with better performance on these dimensions generally being reflected in better financial performance.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Correcting these weaknesses is, first and foremost, the responsibility of the firms' managements and they have powerful incentives to do so.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: But prudential supervisors, including the Federal Reserve, must also review their existing policies and guidance to identify areas where changes could help firms strengthen their risk management--a process that is already under way.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Two areas of focus in this review will be capital and liquidity, the principal buffers that firms have against unexpected shocks.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Regulators should adopt policies that lead financial institutions to hold capital and liquidity cushions commensurate with their firm-wide exposures to adverse market events.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The PWG also will be asking U.S. regulators, working together and through international groups such as the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, to enhance their guidance in a variety of areas in which weaknesses were identified.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: I expect, for example, to see work forthcoming on liquidity risk management, concentration risk management, stress testing, governance of the risk-control framework, and management information systems.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Off-balance-sheet vehicles have been singled out for attention because of the pressures they have put on financial firms' capital and liquidity during the current episode.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The PWG made a number of recommendations on this topic, including urging regulators to require financial institutions to provide more detailed and comprehensive disclosures about off-balance-sheet commitments.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The PWG also recommended that the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) evaluate the need for further modifications to accounting standards related to consolidation and securitization, and that FASB and the International Accounting Standards Board achieve more rapid international convergence of accounting standards in this area.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Implications and Conclusions This quick review of the recommendations of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets does not do justice to the many issues we considered in our discussions and in the work of the staff.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: But I think it does give you a flavor of the diagnosis and recommendations.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Implementing these recommendations here in the United States, as well as working with our international partners to implement compatible and complementary measures abroad, will have many benefits.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Narrowly, these recommendations should help to improve and strengthen the originate-to-distribute model, which, despite recent problems, seems likely to remain an important component of our system of credit provision.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the vision set forth by the PWG, however, this model will be rebuilt on a foundation that includes higher standards of underwriting and due diligence, a closer alignment of the incentives of originators and investors, greater transparency and simplicity in the design of credit instruments and in the determination of credit ratings, and better risk and liquidity management by financial institutions that develop and hold these instruments.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: More broadly, these recommendations should moderate the likelihood and severity of future financial shocks and enable market participants to better withstand shocks when they occur.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Importantly, the PWG's approach relies on both market and regulatory discipline, not just one or the other.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: With respect to market discipline, in light of recent experience, investors are unlikely to rely solely on credit ratings in the future but will instead require more and better information from originators and sponsors of credit products.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Credit rating agencies will also be tougher about the information they demand from securitizers, and I expect they will be more skeptical about especially complex and opaque instruments.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To support these efforts to strengthen market discipline, the PWG called for the private sector to establish several working groups to make recommendations concerning best practices in key areas.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Regulation complements market discipline--for example, by requiring disclosures that improve the ability of consumers to shop and of investors to evaluate risks, by providing protections to less-sophisticated market participants (such as subprime mortgage borrowers), and by requiring that financial institutions meet high standards in their management of risk.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We regulators must act to ensure that our policies and supervisory procedures are consistent with the objectives of improving the originate-to-distribute system and strengthening risk management more broadly.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We will review some aspects of our regulations and strengthen our supervisory guidance and disclosure requirements in key areas, such as those relating to securitizations and off-balance-sheet vehicles.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We will review our own use of credit ratings as a risk metric.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: And we must be sure that we are working effectively with both the private sector and other domestic and international regulators to help the system function better.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The process of implementing the PWG's implementations will be challenging, in no small measure because of the continuing pressures of short-term crisis management.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, we do not have the luxury of waiting for markets to stabilize before we think about the future.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Indeed, many of the necessary changes that have been identified, including increasing transparency, improving risk management, and attaining better coordination among regulators, could provide important support to the process of normalizing our financial markets.
speech_title: Addressing Weaknesses in the Global Financial Markets: The Report of the President's Working Group on Financial Markets
speech_venue: At the World Affairs Council of Greater Richmond's Virginia Global Ambassador Award Luncheon, Richmond, Virginia
