speaker: Kohn
text: Market participants, scholars, and central bankers and other policymakers have long recognized that liquid money markets are critical to financial stability.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Many banks and other financial market participants obtain a significant portion of their funding in the money markets and rely on rolling over such short-term debt.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Developments in global financial markets since last summer have underscored that if market participants become concerned about their access to money market funding, they can pull back from providing credit to other financial market participants and to businesses and households.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Furthermore, certain liquidity tools traditionally used by central banks may not be fully effective in restoring liquidity to the money markets and containing the threats such money market disturbances pose to financial stability.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: We all need to reflect carefully on these developments and draw appropriate lessons regarding the management of liquidity risk and the design of central bank liquidity facilities.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: The Role of Money Markets in the Recent and Ongoing Financial Market Turmoil The financial turmoil that we have been experiencing since last summer clearly did not originate in the money markets.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: As everyone knows, the trigger was losses associated with soaring delinquencies on U.S. subprime mortgages that were originated from 2005 through early 2007, a period during which underwriting standards for such mortgages weakened dramatically.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: But the loosening of standards and terms on subprime mortgages was also symptomatic of a broader erosion of the underwriting of loans to households and businesses.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Many of those loans had been packaged as asset-backed securities and sold to investors who relied on the credit ratings of the securities rather than thoroughly conducting their own due diligence on the securities' risk characteristics.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: When those investors experienced significant losses on even the most highly rated securities backed by subprime collateral, they lost confidence in the ratings and pulled back from markets for a range of asset-backed securities, especially those with more complex structures.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: During the spring and early summer of 2007, the pullback by investors began to put pressure on the liquidity of banks and other financial institutions that had originated large volumes of loans with the expectation of distributing them.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: That pressure became severe and widespread when the liquidity of the asset-backed commercial paper (ABCP) markets became impaired in early August 2007.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Money markets, like that for ABCP, are especially vulnerable to a decline in confidence because so many investors in that sector, such as money market funds, are seeking assured safety and liquidity.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: And well-functioning money markets are critical to the originate-to-distribute model of financial intermediation that has become an increasingly important means of funneling savings into investment.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Originators and packagers need the money markets to fund loans accumulated for later resale; and liquidity in securitization markets depends on dealers being able to borrow in money markets to hold inventories acquired in the process of making markets.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: An illustration of such dependency is that problems in money markets fed back on mortgage markets last year because many securitized loans were being financed on a more permanent basis with short-term money market paper, such as ABCP.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: I believe that the depth, scope, and persistence of the financial turmoil we have been experiencing is in significant part attributable to broader concerns about the liquidity of money markets.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: A loss of liquidity in a money market generally has more serious effects than a loss of liquidity in markets for longer-term instruments because such large amounts of money market instruments become due each day.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: If investors pull back from a money market, the issuers come under substantial liquidity pressures very suddenly.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In the case of ABCP, with the exception of paper issued by structured investment vehicles (SIVs) and so-called extendible paper, issuers were able to meet those liquidity demands by drawing on committed lines of credit from banks.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: But that simply transferred the liquidity pressure to the banking system.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Banks generally were able to cope with that pressure, but the need to fund the draws on their backup lines ate substantially into their liquidity and capital buffers.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Thus, credit problems in mortgage markets helped reduce the availability of credit across a wide variety of instruments and borrowers.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: The pressure on their liquidity and on their balance sheets, combined with heightened credit concerns, made banks reluctant to provide others with term funding--that is, money market loans with terms longer than overnight.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Term premiums embodied in interbank money markets increased markedly; at times the spreads between term dollar Libor and comparable-maturity overnight index swap rates exceeded 100 basis points, and term premiums of comparable magnitude also emerged in interbank markets for sterling and euros.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Securities firms and hedge funds also found term funding considerably more costly and difficult to obtain after the strains emerged in the ABCP markets.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Convinced that the illiquidity of money markets and persistently enlarged term premiums were a significant impediment to restoring the effectiveness of financial market functioning, the Federal Reserve in late 2007 and early 2008 took steps to make borrowing at the discount window more attractive to banks and provided greater liquidity to primary dealers in U.S. government securities by extending the maturity of its open market operations.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: For a time those actions seemed to be reducing the pressures in term funding markets.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: However, in mid-March events once again demonstrated how disruptions to money markets can threaten financial stability.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Growing concerns about the financial condition of Bear Stearns undermined the confidence of its creditors and counterparties and in a few days eroded what it and its regulator had judged to be an ample liquidity cushion.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Although the demands on its liquidity took many forms, the principal drain resulted from the reluctance of creditors and counterparties to roll over the overnight secured transactions that Bear Stearns used to finance a substantial portion of its balance sheet.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Unable to roll over those transactions, Bear Stearns would have been forced to file for bankruptcy unless other sources of financing became available.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: A bankruptcy filing would have forced its secured creditors to liquidate the underlying collateral, which would have added to already severe downward pressures on prices given the illiquidity of the markets for some of this collateral.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Those creditors and counterparties, which included money market funds and other highly risk-averse investors, might well have responded to the sharp and unexpected reduction in the liquidity of their portfolios, as well as to possible losses and a heightened risk of future losses, by pulling back from providing secured financing to other primary dealers.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In those circumstances, in which a much broader and less containable liquidity crisis threatened to emerge, the Federal Reserve Board judged that it needed to use its emergency liquidity powers to avoid a bankruptcy filing by Bear Stearns.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Furthermore, to reduce the potential for counterparties and creditors to make a run on other primary dealers, the Federal Reserve used its emergency lending authority to create a new facility that provided the primary dealers with a liquidity backstop similar to the discount window available to banks in generally sound financial condition.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: These actions by the Federal Reserve and other central banks have contributed to some improvements in the liquidity of term money markets.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: But market functioning remains far from normal.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In particular, although spreads between Libor and comparable swap rates have receded from their recent peaks, they remain abnormally high.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Until the market turmoil fully abates, we run some risk in trying to draw lessons from recent experience.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Nonetheless, I believe experience to date has taught some lessons regarding the management of liquidity risk by market participants and the design of central bank liquidity facilities that will prove durable.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Liquidity Risk Management Recent developments suggest that market participants must thoroughly reassess the market-liquidity assumptions that underlie their existing risk-management practices.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: The scope and duration of disruptions to market liquidity that we have experienced since last summer have greatly exceeded what market participants, prudential supervisors, and central banks thought likely or even possible.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: The implications are quite broad and significant.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In general, in determining the appropriate size of their liquidity buffers (their holdings of unencumbered liquid assets or their access to very stable sources of funding), market participants must plan for the possibility of more-severe liquidity shocks.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: For example, originators and distributors of securitized assets need to be prepared for the possibility that the securitization markets seize up and force them to fund loans in the securitization pipeline.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Banks that provide liquidity backstops to the ABCP markets or to other issuers of short-term liabilities need to prepare for the possibility that broad disturbances to money market liquidity force many issuers to draw upon the backstop facilities at the same time.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: And sponsors of ABCP programs and other facilities in which short-term liabilities fund longer-term assets need to recognize that reputational concerns may induce them to purchase paper that cannot otherwise be sold or to purchase the collateral that cannot be financed.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Perhaps most important, market participants must reassess their assumptions about the stability of secured funding in circumstances in which the liquidity of the markets for the underlying collateral becomes impaired.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: That reassessment is especially important because in recent years market participants have been funding growing volumes of relatively less liquid assets though secured financings in the money markets.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In the ABCP markets, collateral expanded beyond short-term corporate and consumer receivables to include large amounts of paper that SIVs and other "securities arbitrage" programs used to finance mortgage-backed securities, other asset-backed securities, and long-term debt issued by financial institutions.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In the even larger tri-party repo markets, broker-dealers finance not only Treasury securities but also very substantial amounts of agency debt, agency mortgage-backed securities, and various other types of privately-issued debt instruments.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: So long as the markets for the collateral remain liquid, lenders are likely to remain confident that the margin requirements applied to the collateral provide adequate protection against loss.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: But if liquidity evaporates, borrowers whose creditworthiness is questioned can suddenly encounter difficulties financing now-illiquid collateral.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: The primary responsibility for reassessing and strengthening the management of liquidity risk appropriately rests with market participants themselves, but prudential supervisors, working with central banks, should carefully review the practices of regulated entities.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In particular, the public authorities must address a difficult yet very important question: To what degree should entities with access to central bank credit be permitted to rely on that access to meet potential liquidity demands?
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Central bank liquidity facilities are intended to permit those with access to hold smaller liquidity buffers, which allows them to fund more longer-term assets and thereby promotes capital formation and economic growth.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: At the same time, however, the existence of central bank credit facilities can so undermine incentives for maintaining liquidity buffers that institutions hold more longer-term assets than is socially desirable and thereby pose excessive risk to themselves and the financial system.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In principle, prudential regulation of institutions with access to central bank credit can limit moral hazard and induce institutions to hold amounts of longer-term assets and liquid assets that are socially desirable.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In practice, however, this requires difficult and necessarily somewhat arbitrary judgments about the types of liquidity stress scenarios that institutions should plan to confront without access to central bank credit and, correspondingly, those scenarios in which institutions in sound financial condition can appropriately rely on central bank credit.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: For example, for what types of collateral can institutions appropriately assume that secured financing will always be available, because markets for that collateral ordinarily are highly liquid and because if they are not central banks can be expected to take actions to address the situation.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Conversely, for what types of collateral should institutions prepare for a loss of secured funding and for how long a period?
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Although recent experience suggests that these are very important questions, it provides only limited insights regarding the answers.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Central Bank Liquidity Facilities I have already mentioned a number of steps the Federal Reserve has taken to address liquidity problems in money markets, including the creation of new or expanded auction facilities for discount window and securities lending and the opening of our lending facilities to more counterparties.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Many other central banks also found that they needed to adapt their methods of providing liquidity to the unusual pressures associated with the market turmoil since last summer.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Although specific actions varied according to the severity of the pressure and the characteristics of the preexisting operational framework, many central banks concentrated operations more in longer maturities, broadened the range of collateral accepted in various types of operations, and increased the utility of standing loan facilities; some made loans in other currencies by use of swaps with the Federal Reserve, enhanced securities lending operations, and engaged in auctions or other new methods to distribute some kinds of liquidity.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: In many cases, these innovations involved a degree of cooperation in timing or action across central banks.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn
text: Normally, most central banks supply and absorb reserves primarily in the safest and most liquid parts of the money markets.
speech_title: Money Markets and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia Business School Conference on the Role of Money Markets, New York, New York

speaker: Kohn

text: For the United States, of course, perhaps the most difficult and important question involves access to central bank credit facilities by U.S. broker-dealers, including the primary dealers.

text: And, in the case of Bear Stearns, we saw that a run on a major broker-dealer when markets were already disrupted by a flight to safety and liquidity could, through a chain of actions and reactions, threaten financial stability.
