text: Chairman Bernanke presented identical remarks to the Risk Transfer Mechanisms and Financial Stability Workshop, Basel, Switzerland, on May 29, 2008 (via videoconference)
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Well-functioning financial markets are an essential link in the transmission of monetary policy to the economy and a critical foundation for economic growth and stability.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, since August, severe financial strains have shaken this foundation.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: A sharp housing contraction has generated substantial losses on many mortgage-related assets and a broad-based tightening in credit availability.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Consistent with its role as the nation's central bank, the Federal Reserve has responded not only with an easing of monetary policy but also with a number of steps aimed at reducing funding pressures for depository institutions and primary securities dealers and at improving overall market liquidity and market functioning.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In my remarks today, I will begin by reviewing the principles that should guide central banks' actions to support market liquidity.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Then, in light of those principles, I will discuss the liquidity measures implemented by the Federal Reserve in response to the financial turmoil.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: I will conclude by offering some thoughts on liquidity regulation.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Principles Behind Central Bank Liquidity Provisions The notion that a central bank should provide liquidity to the banking system in a crisis has a long intellectual lineage.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Walter Bagehot's Lombard Street , published in 1873, remains one of the classic treatments of the role of the central bank in the management of financial crises.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Bagehot noted that the basis of a successful credit system is confidence.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In one passage, he writes, "Credit means that a certain confidence is given, and a certain trust reposed.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: and is that confidence wise?
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: These are the cardinal questions" (p. 11).
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: He pointed out that confidence is particularly important in banking and in other situations in which the lender's own liabilities are viewed as very liquid by its creditors.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In such situations, as Bagehot put it, "â¦where the 'liabilities,' or promises to pay, are so large, and the time at which to pay them, if exacted, is so short," borrowers must demonstrate "an instant capacity to meet engagements" (p. 11).
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Meeting creditors' demands for payment requires holding liquidity--cash, essentially, or close equivalents.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: But neither individual institutions, nor the private sector as a whole, can maintain enough cash on hand to meet a demand for liquidation of all, or even a substantial fraction of, short-term liabilities.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Doing so would be both unprofitable and socially undesirable.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: It would be unprofitable because cash pays a lower return than other investments.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: And it would be socially undesirable, because an excessive preference for liquid assets reduces society's ability to fund longer-term investments that carry a high return but cannot be liquidated quickly.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, holding liquid assets that are only a fraction of short-term liabilities presents an obvious risk.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: If most or all creditors, for lack of confidence or some other reason, demand cash at the same time, a borrower that finances longer-term assets with liquid liabilities will not be able to meet the demand.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: It would be forced either to defer or suspend payments or to sell some of its less-liquid assets (presumably at steep discounts) to make the payments.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Either option may lead to the failure of the borrower, so that the loss of confidence, even if not originally justified by fundamentals, will tend to be self-confirming.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: If the loss of confidence becomes more general, a broader crisis may ensue.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: How should a central bank respond to a sharp increase in the demand for cash or equivalents by private creditors?
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Before talking about Bagehot's answer, I should note that the Bank of England in his time was a hybrid institution--it was privately owned by shareholders, but it also had a public role.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: To fulfill its public role, the Bank of England did not in all cases maximize its profits; notably, it held a larger share of its assets in liquid form than did other banks, thereby foregoing some return.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Nevertheless, in the context of the gold standard, the Bank's stock of liquid assets was relatively modest in size, raising the possibility that even this quasi-public institution could run out of cash should the demand for liquidity become high enough.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: 2 In this context, Bagehot's advice on how the Bank of England should respond to a generalized liquidity shortage was somewhat counterintuitive.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: And what are the terms at which the central bank should lend freely?
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Bagehot argues that "these loans should only be made at a very high rate of interest" (p. 99).
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Some modern commentators have rationalized Bagehot's dictum to lend at a high or "penalty" rate as a way to mitigate moral hazard--that is, to help maintain incentives for private-sector banks to provide for adequate liquidity in advance of any crisis.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: I will return to the issue of moral hazard later.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: But it is worth pointing out briefly that, in fact, the risk of moral hazard did not appear to be Bagehot's principal motivation for recommending a high rate; rather, he saw it as a tool to dissuade unnecessary borrowing and thus to help protect the Bank of England's own finite store of liquid assets.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: 3 Today, potential limitations on the central bank's lending capacity are not nearly so pressing an issue as in Bagehot's time, when the central bank's ability to provide liquidity was far more tenuous.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Bagehot defined a financial crisis largely in terms of a banking panic--that is, a situation in which depositors rapidly and simultaneously attempt to withdraw funds from their bank accounts.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the 19th century, such panics were a lethal threat for banks that were financing long-term loans with demand deposits that could be called at any time.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In modern financial systems, the combination of effective banking supervision and deposit insurance has substantially reduced the threat of retail deposit runs.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Nonetheless, recent events demonstrate that liquidity risks are always present for institutions--banks and nonbanks alike--that finance illiquid assets with short-term liabilities.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, since August, mortgage lenders, commercial and investment banks, and structured investment vehicles have experienced great difficulty in rolling over commercial paper backed by subprime and other mortgages.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: More broadly, a loss of confidence in credit ratings led to a sharp contraction in the asset-backed commercial paper market as short-term investors withdrew their funds.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: And remarkably, some financial institutions have even experienced pressures in rolling over maturing repurchase agreements (repos).
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: I say "remarkably" because, until recently, short-term repos had always been regarded as virtually risk-free instruments and thus largely immune to the type of rollover or withdrawal risks associated with short-term unsecured obligations.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In March, rapidly unfolding events demonstrated that even repo markets could be severely disrupted when investors believe they might need to sell the underlying collateral in illiquid markets.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Such forced asset sales can set up a particularly adverse dynamic, in which further substantial price declines fan investor concerns about counterparty credit risk, which then feed back in the form of intensifying funding pressures.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Recent research by Allen and Gale (2007) confirms that, in principle at least, "fire sales" forced by sharp increases in investors' liquidity preference can drive asset prices below their fundamental value, at significant cost to the financial system and the economy.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Their work underscores the basic logic in Bagehot's prescription for crisis management: A central bank may be able to eliminate, or at least attenuate, adverse outcomes by making cash loans secured by borrowers' illiquid but sound assets.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Thus, borrowers can avoid selling securities into an illiquid market, and the potential for economic damage--arising, for example, from the unavailability of credit for productive purposes or the inefficient liquidation of long-term investments--is substantially reduced.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Liquidity Powers of Other Central Banks This prescription for providing liquidity in a crisis is simple in theory, but, in practice, it can be far more complicated.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: For instance, how should the central bank distinguish between institutions whose liquidity pressures stem primarily from a breakdown in financial market functioning and those whose problems fundamentally derive from underlying concerns about their solvency?
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The answer, at times, is by no means straightforward.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: There are other complexities, too.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Central banks provide liquidity through a variety of mechanisms, including open market operations and direct credit extension through standing lending facilities.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The choice of tools in a crisis depends on the circumstances as well as on specific institutional factors.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The European Central Bank (ECB), for example, routinely conducts open market operations with a wide range of counterparties against a broad range of collateral.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In recent months, in light of intense pressures in term funding markets, the ECB has provided relatively large quantities of reserves through longer-term open market operations.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Extending this strategy, the ECB also introduced a new refinancing operation with a six-month maturity.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The first of these was executed on April 2 and was well received.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Bank of England has followed a similar strategy, expanding their term open market operations and accepting a wider range of collateral.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Very recently, the Bank of England also initiated a special liquidity facility that allows banks to swap high-quality mortgage-backed and other securities for U.K. Treasury bills.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Differences in legal and institutional structure have affected the methods used by various central banks to inject liquidity in their markets.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the United States, in ordinary circumstances only depository institutions have direct access to the discount window, and open market operations are conducted with just a small set of primary dealers against a narrow range of highly liquid collateral.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In contrast, in jurisdictions with universal banking, the distinction between depository institutions and other types of financial institutions is much less relevant in defining access to central bank liquidity than is the case in the United States.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Moreover, some central banks (such as the ECB) have greater flexibility than the Federal Reserve in the types of collateral they can accept in open market operations.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: As a result, some foreign central banks have been able to address the recent liquidity pressures within their existing frameworks without resorting to extraordinary measures.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In contrast, the Federal Reserve has had to use methods it does not usually employ to address liquidity pressures across a number of markets and institutions.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In effect, the Federal Reserve has had to innovate in large part to achieve what other central banks have been able to effect through existing tools.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The financial distress since August has also underscored the importance of international cooperation among central banks.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: For some time, central banks have recognized that managing crises involving large financial institutions operating across national borders and in multiple currencies can present difficult challenges.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Funding pressures can easily arise in more than one currency and in more than one jurisdiction.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In such cases, central banks may find it essential to work closely together.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: For just this reason, the Federal Reserve, the ECB, and the Swiss National Bank have established currency swap arrangements and have coordinated their provision of dollar liquidity to international financial institutions over recent months.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Federal Reserve Liquidity Operations In the United States, open market operations have long been the principal tool used by the Federal Reserve to manage the aggregate level of reserves in the banking system and thereby control the federal funds rate.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The discount window has typically functioned as a backstop, serving as a source of reserves when conditions in the federal funds market tighten significantly or when individual depository institutions experience short-term funding pressures.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Throughout much of the Federal Reserve's history, this basic structure has proven adequate to address liquidity pressures, even during some periods of market turmoil.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, it became abundantly clear that this traditional framework for liquidity provision was not up to addressing the recent strains in short-term funding markets.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, the efficacy of the discount window has been limited by the reluctance of depository institutions to use the window as a source of funding.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The "stigma" associated with the discount window, which if anything intensifies during periods of crisis, arises primarily from banks' concerns that market participants will draw adverse inferences about their financial condition if their borrowing from the Federal Reserve were to become known.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve has taken steps to make discount window borrowing through the regular primary credit program more attractive.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Most notably, we narrowed the spread of the primary credit rate over the target federal funds rate from 100 basis points in August to only 25 basis points today.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In addition, to address the pressures in term funding markets, we now permit depositories to borrow for as long as 90 days, renewable at their discretion so long as they remain in sound financial condition.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: These actions have had some success in increasing depository institutions' willingness to borrow.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Moreover, the existence of the option to borrow through the discount window, even if not exercised, likely has improved confidence by assuring depository institutions that backstop liquidity will be available should they need it.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Still, the continuing disruptions in short-term funding markets over recent months suggested that new ways of providing liquidity were necessary.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Last December, the Federal Reserve introduced the Term Auction Facility, or TAF, through which predetermined amounts of discount window credit are auctioned every two weeks to eligible borrowers for terms of 28 days.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In effect, TAF auctions are very similar to open market operations, but conducted with depository institutions rather than primary dealers and against a much broader range of collateral than is accepted in standard open market operations.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The TAF, apparently because of its competitive auction format and the certainty that a large amount of credit would be made available, appears to have overcome the stigma problem to a significant degree.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Indeed, a large number of banks--ranging from 52 to more than 90--have participated in each of the 11 auctions held thus far.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The TAF has also simplified the implementation of monetary policy by providing greater predictability of the level of borrowings by depository institutions and consequently of bank reserves.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The size of individual TAF auctions has been raised over time from $20 billion at the inception of the program to $75 billion in the auctions this month.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: We stand ready to increase the size of the auctions further if warranted by financial developments.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The recent market turmoil has also affected the liquidity positions of financial institutions that do not ordinarily have access to the discount window.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, prior to the recent experience, it was believed that primary dealers were not especially susceptible to runs by their creditors.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Primary dealers typically rely on short-term secured financing arrangements, and the collateralization of those borrowings was thought sufficient to maintain the confidence of investors.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Consequently, dealers' liquidity management policies and contingency plans were typically based on the assumption that they would not be faced with a sudden loss of financing.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: But these beliefs were predicated on the assumption that financial markets would always be reasonably liquid.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: As I have already noted, recent events have proven that assumption unwarranted, and the risk developed that liquidity pressures might force dealers to sell assets into already illiquid markets.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: This might have resulted in Allen and Gale's fire sale scenario that I mentioned earlier, in which a cascade of failures and liquidations sharply depresses asset prices, with adverse financial and economic implications.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: This heightened risk led the Federal Reserve to expand its ability to supply liquidity to primary dealers.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In March, to ease strains that had developed in the agency mortgage-backed securities market, the Federal Reserve initiated as part of its open-market operations a series of single-tranche repurchase transactions with terms of roughly 28 days and cumulating to up to $100 billion.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: For the purposes of these transactions, primary dealers can deliver as collateral any securities eligible in conventional open market operations.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Additionally, the Federal Reserve introduced the Term Securities Lending Facility (TSLF), which allows primary dealers to exchange less-liquid securities for Treasury securities for terms of 28 days at an auction-determined fee.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Recently, the Federal Reserve expanded the list of securities eligible for such transactions to include all AAA/Aaa-rated asset-backed securities.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: By mid-March, however, the pressures in short-term financing markets intensified, and market participants were speculating about the financial condition of Bear Stearns, a prominent investment bank.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: On March 13, Bear advised the Federal Reserve and other government agencies that its liquidity position had significantly deteriorated, and that it would be forced to file for bankruptcy the next day unless alternative sources of funds became available.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: A bankruptcy filing would have forced Bear's secured creditors and counterparties to liquidate the underlying collateral and, given the illiquidity of markets, those creditors and counterparties might well have sustained losses.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: If they responded to losses or the unexpected illiquidity of their holdings by pulling back from providing secured financing to other firms, a much broader liquidity crisis would have ensued.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In such circumstances, the Federal Reserve Board judged that it was appropriate to use its emergency lending authorities under the Federal Reserve Act to avoid a disorderly closure of Bear.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Accordingly, the Federal Reserve, in close consultation with the Treasury Department, agreed to provide short-term funding to Bear Stearns through JPMorgan Chase.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Over the following weekend, JPMorgan Chase agreed to purchase Bear Stearns and assumed the company's financial obligations.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve, again in close consultation with the Treasury Department, agreed to supply term funding, secured by $30 billion in Bear Stearns assets, to facilitate the purchase.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In a further effort to short-circuit a possible downward spiral in financing markets, the Federal Reserve used its emergency authorities to create the Primary Dealer Credit Facility (PDCF).
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The PDCF allows primary dealers to borrow at the same rate at which depository institutions can access the discount window, with the borrowings able to be secured by a broad range of investment-grade securities.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In effect, the PDCF provides primary dealers with a liquidity backstop similar to the discount window for depository institutions in generally sound financial condition.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: To date, our liquidity measures appear to have contributed to some improvement in financing markets.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The existence of the PDCF seems to have bolstered confidence among primary dealers' counterparties (including the clearing banks, which provide the dealers with critical intra-day secured credit).
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: In addition, conditions in the Treasury repo market, which became very strained around mid-March, have improved substantially.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Liquidity is better in several other markets as well.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, spreads on agency mortgage-backed securities have dropped in recent weeks after reaching very high levels in mid-March, as have spreads between conforming fixed-rate mortgage rates and Treasury rates.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Spreads on jumbo mortgage loans have retraced a portion of their earlier large increases, but recent regulatory and legislative changes make it difficult to assess the impact of liquidity measures in that segment of the market.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Corporate debt spreads have also declined somewhat from recent highs.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: These are welcome signs, of course, but at this stage conditions in financial markets are still far from normal.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: A number of securitization markets remain moribund, risk spreads--although off their recent peaks--generally remain quite elevated, and pressures in short-term funding markets persist.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Spreads of term dollar Libor over comparable-maturity overnight index swap rates have receded some from their recent peaks but remain abnormally high.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: 4 Funding pressures have also been evident in the strong participation at recent TAF auctions even after the recent expansions in auction sizes, and, of late, depository institutions have borrowed significant amounts under the primary credit program for terms of up to 90 days.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Ultimately, market participants themselves must address the fundamental sources of financial strains--through deleveraging, raising new capital, and improving risk management--and this process is likely to take some time.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve's various liquidity measures should help facilitate that process indirectly by boosting investor confidence and by reducing the risks of severe disruption during the period of adjustment.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Once financial conditions become more normal, the extraordinary provision of liquidity by the Federal Reserve will no longer be needed.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: As Bagehot would surely advise, under normal conditions financial institutions should look to private counterparties and not central banks as a source of ongoing funding.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Liquidity Regulation and Moral Hazard The provision of liquidity by a central bank can help mitigate a financial crisis.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, central banks face a tradeoff when deciding to provide extraordinary liquidity support.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: A central bank that is too quick to act as liquidity provider of last resort risks inducing moral hazard; specifically, if market participants come to believe that the Federal Reserve or other central banks will take such measures whenever financial stress develops, financial institutions and their creditors would have less incentive to pursue suitable strategies for managing liquidity risk and more incentive to take such risks.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Although central banks should give careful consideration to their criteria for invoking extraordinary liquidity measures, the problem of moral hazard can perhaps be most effectively addressed by prudential supervision and regulation that ensures that financial institutions manage their liquidity risks effectively in advance of the crisis.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: Recall Bagehot's advice: "The time for economy and for accumulation is before.
speech_title: Liquidity Provision by the Federal Reserve
speech_venue: At the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Financial Markets Conference, Sea Island, Georgia (via satellite)

speaker: Bernanke
text: A good banker will have accumulated in ordinary times the reserve he is to make use of in extraordinary times" (p. 24).
