speech_venue: At the Caesarea Forum of the Israel Democracy Institute, Eliat, Israel

speaker: Bernanke
text: I would like to thank Chairman Bair for inviting me to address this conference on mortgage lending to low- and moderate-income households.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The decision to own a home is one of the most important decisions that families make.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Whether owning a home is the right choice for a particular individual (or family) depends on many factors specific to the individual.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, for those who are willing and financially prepared to undertake homeownership, we look to our financial system to provide access to mortgage credit in ways appropriately tailored to each borrower's needs.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Unfortunately, in the past few years, many mortgage loans were extended that were poorly underwritten or whose terms were inadequately disclosed, particularly in the subprime market.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As you know, those poor lending practices have contributed to a sharp increase in mortgage delinquencies and foreclosures.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The resulting costs have been felt not only by borrowers but also by entire communities, as foreclosure clusters have caused neighborhoods to deteriorate and reduced municipal tax bases.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The decline in the national housing market, which has been a major cause of the broader slowdown in economic activity, was in turn greatly exacerbated by the collapse of subprime lending.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: And financial institutions have suffered large losses, with implications for the cost and availability of new credit.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The recent experience, including the broader turmoil we have seen in the financial markets, will have--indeed, is already having--important consequences for U.S. regulatory policy.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: First, regulators are taking action to strengthen consumer protections.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Next week, the Federal Reserve Board will issue new rules on mortgage lending, using its authorities under the Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: These new rules, which will apply to all lenders and not just banks, will address some of the problems that have surfaced in recent years in mortgage lending, especially high-cost mortgage lending.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We received many helpful comments on our proposal and we incorporated a number of them into the final rules.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In another effort to protect consumers, the Board has also recently issued proposals to substantially improve credit card disclosures and to address a number of unfair or deceptive acts and practices in credit card lending.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Second, regulatory policy can help to ensure that mortgage credit is available to qualified borrowers, including those of low and moderate incomes.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, I welcome recent efforts to improve the regulatory oversight of the government-sponsored enterprises, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: If these firms are strong, well-regulated, well-capitalized, and focused on their mission, they will be better able to serve their function of increasing access to mortgage credit, without posing undue risks to the financial system or the taxpayer.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Policymakers are also discussing the modernization of the Federal Housing Administration and the expansion of the products and programs it might offer to make mortgage credit available and to help prevent avoidable foreclosures.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Third, instability in our financial system over the past year or so has importantly affected the availability and terms of credit and the pace of economic growth.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Thus, beyond actions focused on mortgage markets, regulators must consider what can be done to make the U.S. financial system itself more stable, without compromising the dynamism and innovation that has been its hallmark.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Several bodies, including the President's Working Group (PWG) in the United States and the international Financial Stability Forum, have recently issued comprehensive reports on the lessons of the financial turmoil with recommendations for regulators and the private sector.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Many of these recommendations are being implemented, including more stringent regulation of mortgage lending (recommended by the PWG), strengthening of regulatory capital and liquidity management requirements for banks, reforms of the credit rating agencies, and others.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve has been actively involved in developing and implementing these necessary reforms.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the remainder of my remarks, I would like to discuss this more general issue of promoting financial stability, including some of the lessons learned, what the Federal Reserve is already doing, and how we as a society might wish to go about strengthening our financial system for the future.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Bear Stearns Episode and Its Implications As you are aware, one of the key events in financial markets in recent months was the near-bankruptcy in March of the investment bank Bear Stearns.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The collapse of Bear Stearns was triggered by a run of its creditors and customers, analogous to the run of depositors on a commercial bank.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: This run was surprising, however, in that Bear Stearns's borrowings were largely secured--that is, its lenders held collateral to ensure repayment even if the company itself failed.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, the illiquidity of markets in mid-March was so severe that creditors lost confidence that they could recoup their loans by selling the collateral.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Hence, they refused to renew their loans and demanded repayment.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Bear Stearns's contingency planning had not envisioned a sudden loss of access to secured funding, so it did not have adequate liquidity to meet those demands for repayment.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: If a sale of the firm could not have been arranged, it would have filed for bankruptcy.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Our analyses persuaded us and our colleagues at the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Treasury that allowing Bear Stearns to fail so abruptly at a time when the financial markets were already under considerable stress would likely have had extremely adverse implications for the financial system and for the broader economy.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, Bear Stearns' failure under those circumstances would have seriously disrupted certain key secured funding markets and derivatives markets and possibly would have led to runs on other financial firms.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To protect the financial system and the economy, the Federal Reserve facilitated the acquisition of Bear Stearns by the commercial bank JPMorgan Chase.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We supplemented our actions regarding Bear Stearns by establishing the Primary Dealer Credit Facility (PDCF).
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Under the PDCF, the Fed stands ready to make fully collateralized loans to the remaining four major investment banks plus other broker-dealers, called primary dealers, that transact regularly with the Federal Reserve.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: 1 The Fed also created the Term Securities Lending Facility (TSLF), which allows primary dealers to borrow Treasury securities using other types of assets as collateral.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: These new facilities assured the secured creditors of primary dealers that those firms had sufficient access to liquidity, reducing the danger of runs like the one experienced by Bear Stearns.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Although short-term funding markets remain strained, they have improved somewhat since March, reflecting the availability of several Fed lending facilities as well as the ongoing efforts of financial firms to repair their balance sheets and increase their liquidity.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The PDCF and the TSLF were created under the Federal Reserve's emergency lending powers, with the term of the PDCF set for a period of at least six months, through mid-September.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve is strongly committed to supporting the stability and improved functioning of the financial system.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We are currently monitoring developments in financial markets closely and considering several options, including extending the duration of our facilities for primary dealers beyond year-end, should the current unusual and exigent circumstances continue to prevail in dealer funding markets.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: At the same time, we are taking measures that will serve over time to strengthen the primary dealers, other financial institutions, and the overall financial system.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As I will discuss, these measures include working with the SEC and the primary dealers to increase the firms' capital and liquidity buffers and cooperating with other regulators and the private sector to help make the financial infrastructure more resilient.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Prudential Regulation and Supervision In general, our system relies on market discipline to constrain leverage and risk-taking by financial firms, supplemented by prudential oversight when government guarantees (such as deposit insurance) or risks to general financial stability are involved.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, the enormous losses and writedowns taken at financial institutions around the world since August, as well as the run on Bear Stearns, show that, in this episode, neither market discipline nor regulatory oversight succeeded in limiting leverage and risk-taking sufficiently to preserve financial stability.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Working collaboratively with regulators both here and abroad as well as with the firms themselves, the Federal Reserve has redoubled its efforts to strengthen the capital positions, liquidity reserves, and risk-management practices of the institutions for which we have supervisory responsibility, including bank holding companies and state-chartered banks that are members of the Federal Reserve System.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Shareholders, managers, and investors are likewise taking steps to protect their interests in a period of continued market strains.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: From a regulatory and supervisory perspective, the investment banks and the other primary dealers raise some distinct issues.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: First, as I noted, neither the firms nor the regulators anticipated the possibility that investment banks would lose access to secured financing, as Bear Stearns did.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Second, in the absence of countervailing regulatory measures, the Fed's decision to lend to primary dealers--although it was necessary to avoid serious financial disruptions--could tend to make market discipline less effective in the future.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Going forward, the regulation and supervision of these institutions must take account of these realities.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: At the same time, reforms in the oversight of these firms must recognize the distinctive features of investment banking and take care neither to unduly inhibit efficiency and innovation nor to induce a migration of risk-taking activities to institutions that are less regulated or beyond our borders.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Since March, the Federal Reserve has been working closely with the SEC, which is the functional supervisor of each of the primary dealers and the consolidated supervisor of the four large firms that are not affiliated with banks (the so-called investment banks).
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Federal Reserve examiners are in place at the four investment banks and, along with our SEC colleagues, are monitoring the conditions of the other primary dealers.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In cooperation with the SEC and the investment banks themselves, we are evaluating the capital and liquidity positions of these firms with the objective of ensuring that they are strong enough to withstand severe stresses in the financial environment.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the past few months, these firms have raised capital and expanded their liquidity cushions to protect themselves against extreme events.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To formalize our effective working relationship, the SEC and the Federal Reserve recently agreed to a memorandum of understanding (MOU).
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Under the MOU, the SEC and the Fed will freely share information and analyses pertaining to the financial conditions of primary dealers.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The two agencies have also agreed to work jointly with the firms to support their continued efforts to strengthen their balance sheets, their liquidity, and their risk-management practices.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Fed-SEC cooperation is taking place within the existing statutory framework with the objective of addressing the near-term situation.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the longer term, legislation may be needed to provide a more robust framework for the prudential supervision of investment banks and other large securities dealers.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, under current arrangements, the SEC's oversight of the holding companies of the major investment banks is based on a voluntary agreement between the SEC and those firms.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Strong holding company oversight is essential and thus, in my view, the Congress should consider requiring consolidated supervision of those firms, providing the regulator the authority to set standards for capital, liquidity holdings, and risk management.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: 2 More generally, in the longer term, the Congress should consider whether our current regulatory structure needs to be modernized to address the changes that have occurred in the structure of the financial system, including the enormous growth of nonbank financial institutions and the development of new financial products.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Strengthening the Financial Infrastructure The potential vulnerability of the financial system to the collapse of Bear Stearns was exacerbated by weaknesses in the infrastructure of financial markets.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, given current arrangements, Bear Stearns' counterparties on thousands of over-the-counter (OTC) derivatives contracts would likely have had serious difficulty promptly determining their vulnerability to counterparty losses.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Furthermore, their efforts to replace the hedges provided by those contracts would have placed additional pressures on markets that already were quite stressed.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Likewise, providers of short-term secured funding through repurchase agreements (repos) and other forms of secured funding, including money market mutual funds and other conservative investors, could have unexpectedly found themselves holding various forms of collateral rather than the liquid funds they were expecting.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: These investors would probably have been hard-pressed to dispose of this collateral and to manage their liquidity needs in a highly stressed environment.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: More generally, in this scenario, sharply increased uncertainty about the liquidity and financial strength of a wide range of counterparties would likely have greatly reduced the willingness of financial market participants to engage in normal transactions.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve, together with other regulators and the private sector, is engaged in a broad effort to strengthen the financial infrastructure.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In doing so, we aim not only to help make the financial system better able to withstand future shocks but also--by reducing the range of circumstances in which systemic stability concerns might prompt government intervention--to mitigate moral hazard and the problem of "too big to fail."
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: 3 For example, since September 2005, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York has been providing leadership for a major joint initiative by the public and private sectors to improve arrangements for clearing and settling credit default swaps (CDS) and other OTC derivatives.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As a result, derivatives dealers and other market participants have taken a number of steps to enhance post-trade processing of CDS, and in 2006, they expanded the effort to OTC equity derivatives.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: However, the infrastructure for managing these derivatives still is not as efficient or reliable as that for more mature markets, as was evident last summer, when a surge in CDS trading volume greatly increased backlogs of unconfirmed trades.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The New York Fed and other supervisors are working with market participants to fundamentally change how CDS and other OTC derivatives are processed by applying increasingly stringent targets and performance standards.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: They are also emphasizing that dealers must demonstrate their capability to adequately manage the failure of a major counterparty, including calculating exposures rapidly, having clear management procedures, and conducting internal stress exercises.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Finally, they are encouraging the development of well-regulated and prudently managed central counterparty clearing arrangements for CDS trades.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve and other authorities also are focusing on enhancing the resilience of the tri-party repo markets, in which the primary dealers and other large banks and broker-dealers obtain very large amounts of secured financing from money funds and other short-term, risk-averse investors.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: For some time we have been working with market participants to develop a contingency plan should there ever occur a loss of confidence in either of the two clearing banks that facilitate the settlement of tri-party repos.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Recent experience, including Bear Stearns' liquidity problems, demonstrates the need for additional measures to enhance the resilience of these markets, including the development of contingency plans for dealing with the sudden loss of confidence in a large tri-party borrower.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Given the critical role that these markets play in our financial system, we need to proceed in a prudent manner in making changes, especially as long as the broader financial markets are experiencing stress.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Nonetheless, over time, a stronger financial system may require changes in the way borrowers and lenders use these markets, as well as in the settlement infrastructure operated by the clearing banks.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: More generally, both the operational performance under stress of key payment and settlements systems and their ability to manage counterparty and market risks are critical to the stability of the broader financial system.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Currently, the Federal Reserve relies on a patchwork of authorities, largely derived from our role as a banking supervisor, as well as on moral suasion to help ensure that the various payments and settlements systems have the necessary procedures and controls in place to manage their risks.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: By contrast, most major central banks around the world have an explicit statutory basis for their oversight of payment systems, and in recent years a growing number of central banks have been given statutory authority to oversee securities settlement systems as well.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Given how important robust payment and settlement systems are to financial stability, a strong case can be made for granting the Federal Reserve explicit oversight authority for systemically important payment and settlement systems.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Preventing or Mitigating Future Crises The financial turmoil is ongoing, and our efforts today are concentrated on helping the financial system return to more normal functioning.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: It is not too soon, however, to begin to think about the steps we might take to reduce the incidence and severity of future crises.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: I have already noted the importance of strengthening capital, liquidity, and risk management at major financial institutions, including both commercial banks and investment banks.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: These efforts are already underway on a globally coordinated basis.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Together with the improvements to the financial infrastructure I have just discussed, these steps should increase the resilience of the financial system in the face of shocks.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As I have noted, I believe that the Federal Reserve's actions to facilitate the acquisition of Bear Stearns, thereby preventing its bankruptcy and the disorderly liquidation of positions by its counterparties and creditors, were necessary and warranted to head off serious damage to the U.S. financial system and our economy.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: That said, the intended purpose of Federal Reserve lending is to provide liquidity to sound institutions.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: We used our lending powers to facilitate an acquisition of a failing institution only because no other tools were available to the Federal Reserve or any other government body for ensuring an orderly liquidation in a fragile market environment.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As part of its review of how best to increase financial stability, and as has been suggested by Secretary Paulson, the Congress may wish to consider whether new tools are needed for ensuring an orderly liquidation of a systemically important securities firm that is on the verge of bankruptcy, together with a more formal process for deciding when to use those tools.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Because the resolution of a failing securities firm might have fiscal implications, it would be appropriate for the Treasury to take a leading role in any such process, in consultation with the firm's regulator and other authorities.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The details of any such tools and of the associated decisionmaking process require more study.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: As Chairman Bair recently pointed out, one possible model is the process currently in place under the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Improvement Act (FDICIA) for dealing with insolvent commercial banks.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The FDICIA procedures give the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) the authority to act as a receiver for an insolvent bank and to set up a bridge bank to facilitate an orderly liquidation of the firm.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: A bridge bank authority is an important mechanism for minimizing public losses from government intervention while imposing losses on shareholders and unsecured creditors, thereby limiting moral hazard and mitigating any adverse impact of government intervention on market discipline.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The FDICIA law also requires that failing banks be resolved in a way that imposes the least cost to the government (in this case, to the deposit insurance fund), unless the Treasury, the FDIC, the Federal Reserve Board, and the President agree that following the least-cost route would entail significant systemic risk.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The hurdle for using the so-called systemic risk exception is appropriately high, but the flexibility to respond in a true financial emergency is retained.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Designing analogous rules for the prompt and orderly resolution of securities firms is not straightforward, as these firms differ significantly from most commercial banks in their financing, business models, and in other ways.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: 4 Despite the complexities of designing a resolution regime for securities firms, I believe it is worth the effort.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, by setting a high bar for such actions, the adverse effects on market discipline could be minimized.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Another possible step to reduce the incidence and severity of financial crises, recently proposed in the Treasury blueprint for regulatory reform, would be to task the Federal Reserve with promoting the overall stability of financial markets.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To some extent, the Fed already plays that role, and indeed its founding in 1913 was prompted largely by the desire of the Congress to address the problem of recurring financial panics.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In recent decades, the Federal Reserve has figured prominently in the government's attempts to address a range of financial crises, in part because of the broad expertise derived from the Fed's wide range of activities.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Moreover, the Fed is the only agency that has the power to serve as a liquidity provider of last resort, a power that has proved critical in financial crises throughout history.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: That said, holding the Fed more formally accountable for promoting financial stability makes sense only if the institution's powers are consistent with its responsibilities.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, as a practical matter, I do not think that the Fed could fully meet these objectives without the authority to directly examine banks and other financial institutions that are subject to prudential regulation.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: During the recent financial turmoil, the ability of the Fed to obtain information directly from key institutions and from supervisory reviews has been invaluable for understanding financial developments and their implications for the economy.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: To fulfill its responsibilities, the Fed would also need to have the ability to look at financial firms as a whole, much as we do today when we exercise our umbrella authority over financial holding companies, and the authority to set expectations and require corrective actions as warranted in cases in which firms' actions have potential implications for financial stability.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Finally, to identify financial vulnerabilities, the Fed would need general authority to collect information on the structure and workings of financial markets.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In particular, the recent experience has clearly illustrated the importance, for the purpose of promoting financial stability, of having detailed information about money markets and the activities of borrowers and lenders in those markets.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: If the Congress chooses to go in this direction, attention should be paid to the risk that market participants might incorrectly view the Fed as a source of unconditional support for financial institutions and markets, which could lead to an unacceptable reduction in market discipline.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: If the Federal Reserve's formal mandate were broadened to encompass financial stability, it would be particularly important to make clear that any government intervention to avoid the disorderly liquidation of firms on the verge of bankruptcy should use clearly defined tools and processes, along the lines I discussed earlier.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Conclusion The financial turmoil since August underscores the need to find ways to make the financial system more resilient and stable.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In my remarks today, I have noted several broad areas in which constructive work might be done, including improving the regulation and supervision of financial institutions, strengthening the financial infrastructure, and the possible development of a new resolution process for securities firms.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: In the longer term, it is up to the Congress to determine whether still broader reforms are needed.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Making that determination will raise a host of complex and challenging issues, but the stakes are commensurately high.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Financial crises have occurred periodically around the world for literally hundreds of years, and it is unrealistic to hope that they can be entirely eliminated, especially while maintaining a dynamic and innovative financial system.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Nonetheless, recent experience has illustrated once again that financial instability can have serious economic costs.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: The Federal Reserve will continue its efforts to make our financial system stronger and more resilient, so that it can continue to play its necessary role of supporting economic growth and making credit available to all qualified borrowers.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Primary dealers are banks and securities broker-dealers that trade in U.S. government securities with the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: On behalf of the Federal Reserve System, the New York Fed's Open Market Desk engages in the trades to implement monetary policy.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Bank-affiliated primary dealers are already subject to mandatory consolidated supervision, but the focus of that supervision has been on limiting risks to the banks and other insured depository institutions within the holding company.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: Existing provisions may need to be modified to provide regulatory authority to assess and limit risks to all functionally regulated entities, including securities subsidiaries, as well.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: On the problem of "too big to fail," see for example Gary Stern and Ron Feldman (2004), Too Big to Fail: The Hazards of Bank Bailouts , Washington: Brookings Institution Press.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Bernanke
text: For example, many securities firms book a large share of their assets at affiliates of the broker-dealer, including affiliates abroad that are subject to foreign bankruptcy laws.
speech_title: Financial Regulation and Financial Stability
speech_venue: At the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Forum on Mortgage Lending for Low and Moderate Income Households, Arlington, Virginia

speaker: Kroszner
text: I am delighted to be here to participate in today's discussion about how we can work together to foster and preserve the strength and vitality of minority depository institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: These institutions serve essential roles.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Most important, they extend credit--which is essential to economic development and progress--to businesses and individuals in neighborhoods that otherwise may not have ready access to loans.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: They also foster a spirit of entrepreneurship in their communities, offer customized financial literacy education, and create products and services that address their clients' particular needs.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Taken together, such activities help entrepreneurs and emerging small businesses develop and create employment, encourage the prudent and productive use of credit, and ensure more-vibrant communities and a better quality of life.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: In my remarks this morning, I will focus on two important Federal Reserve initiatives.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: First, I will update you on our new Partnership for Progress program, which is designed to foster and support minority-owned and de novo depository institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Second, I plan to discuss the recent finalization of significant Federal Reserve rules implementing certain provisions of the Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Partnership for Progress Following my promise at last year's interagency conference in Miami, I am excited to announce that we have made good on our pledge to design a proactive training and technical assistance program for minority depository institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Our initiative, known as the Partnership for Progress, was launched nationwide on June 18.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The innovative outreach and technical assistance program seeks to help minority-owned and de novo institutions confront their unique challenges, cultivate safe and sound practices, and compete more effectively in today's marketplace through a combination of one-on-one guidance, targeted workshops, and an extensive web-based resource and information center.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: As locally focused institutions that have deep contacts with financial professionals in their regions, the Reserve Banks have been able to ensure that we tailor the Partnership for Progress program as closely as possible to the specific needs of the institutions participating as well as the customers they serve.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: This program illustrates the advantages of the Federal Reserve System's unique decentralized geographical structure, which consists of the Board of Governors in Washington, D.C., and the twelve Reserve Banks that each represent a different region of the country.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We also consulted with a number of executives from minority depository institutions to better understand the unique challenges that minority-owned depositories confront in raising capital, managing risks, and attracting the right talent.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: This process has been invaluable in helping us to target our efforts and to focus on designing a program that the minority depository institutions have told us is most crucial to them.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: In recent months, I have had an opportunity to see firsthand the challenges that communities are facing in various parts of the country, which has underscored to me the importance of programs like Partnership for Progress.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: I have met with local community groups, bankers, housing advocates, counseling agencies, and state and local government officials in many cities, including Atlanta, Boston, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Las Vegas, Miami, Minneapolis, and Philadelphia.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: As I planned for my participation in this conference, one example stood out.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: While in Atlanta, I visited a predominantly African-American community.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: In this community that spanned several miles, there were a number of vacant homes, conditions mirroring those that I have seen in other neighborhoods.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: However, what was different in this case, and quite disappointing, was that not a single financial institution was within view.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: This lack of local financial institution presence is a problem that is not unique to African-American communities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Indeed, this absence occurs far too frequently in predominantly minority communities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Our new program is intended to enhance the vital role that minority-owned institutions can play in making financial services more available and in providing access to credit in historically underserved communities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: At the core of our program, we have implemented a series of web-based modules designed to assist banks in addressing three distinctive development stages:  (1) starting a bank, (2) managing its transition from a start-up to an established bank, and (3) building shareholder value once a bank has been established on a sound footing.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: These easy-to-use modules are presented on the program's dedicated website-- http://www.fedpartnership.gov/ --and are available for your review and use at any time.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The first module of the program, "Starting a Bank," provides useful guidance on the factors that must be considered in chartering a new bank.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: It includes background information that details regulatory capital requirements, discusses the steps required to file an application, and explains the responsibilities of a bank's board of directors.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The module has video narratives of some of the key topics to provide additional insights into, for instance, the strategic importance of strong capital for all financial institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Since the program was launched, "Start a Bank" has been among the most popular pages on the website.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The second module, "Managing Transition," focuses on the benefits that a bank can derive from well-planned growth.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Because maintaining competitive products and services is a very important aspect of managing growth, we have included a video clip on how minority depository institutions can use the natural branding inherent in their mission to stay ahead of the competition and differentiate themselves.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: This module provides some examples of approaches and strategies to establishing a bank that have been successfully followed by other new institutions to achieve stable and profitable performance.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The third and final module, "Growing Shareholder Value," is designed to help more-mature institutions achieve an even stronger financial footing and improve shareholder value.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: This module addresses key topics, such as corporate governance and performance measurement, that can help to ensure that management remains on target with the overall goals of the organization.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Given that most minority depository institutions are at this stage of life-cycle development, we expect the topics in this segment, such as "Demographic Analysis,"  "New Product Implementation," and "Outsourcing and Vendor Management," to be particularly useful.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We expect minority institutions will use the program to help them navigate three of the most challenging periods in the life cycle of any financial institution.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: I expect that the program, which draws on insights from economics, accounting, finance, and regulatory compliance, will become a valuable resource for institutions at different stages of their development.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: In order to further expand the support that we can offer to these institutions, the Federal Reserve also plans to conduct periodic training sessions for interested participants that will address topics of particular concern and relevance to minority depositories and their bank holding companies.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We also have designated Partnership for Progress contacts in each of the twelve Reserve Bank districts and at the Board to answer questions and coordinate assistance for institutions requesting guidance.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

text: 1 I hope that you will consider contacting us for support or to provide additional suggestions for improving this evolving program.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

text: We are pleased with the initial feedback we have received since the program's launch and will continue to fine-tune and enhance the program over time.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection

text: In that respect, we look forward to continuing to work with you to make this exciting program even more effective.

speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

text: The current wave of foreclosures is taking a very real toll on families and their communities, no place more so than in predominantly minority communities, where subprime loans were particularly common.
