text: The U.S. mortgage market has seen rapid innovation in recent years.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Changes, such as automated underwriting models, the evolution of the secondary markets, and specialization, have had many positive effects.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Some changes in practices, however, have not been so salutary.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Abusive loans that strip borrowers' equity or cause them to lose their homes should not be tolerated.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Too many homeowners and communities are suffering today because of these practices, and the Federal Reserve Board's rules will better protect consumers while preserving their access to credit as they make some of the most important financial decisions of their lives.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Last December, the Board proposed changes using our authority under the Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: In formulating that proposal, the Board sought a wide range of input and information through hearings and meetings throughout the country.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: In response, we received, and considered, over 4,500 comment letters sent to us from community groups, industry participants, consumer advocates, and other interested individuals.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We engaged in outreach to commenters to get clarification of their concerns and weigh competing viewpoints.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We gathered available data and conducted updated analyses.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We undertook on-the-ground consumer testing, which has proven to be an invaluable tool for us in determining policy effectiveness, to gauge the practical effects of one of the proposed rules on individual consumers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Listening carefully to the commenters, collecting and analyzing data, and undertaking consumer testing, I believe, have led to more-effective and improved final rules.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Our goal throughout this process has been to protect borrowers from practices that are unfair or deceptive and to preserve the availability of credit from responsible mortgage lenders.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: These rules expand upon interagency guidance issued last year on subprime loans.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: That guidance, however, only focused on certain specific subprime products, hybrid adjustable-rate mortgages, such as so called 2/28s and 3/27s, and only applied to federally supervised institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Our rules now apply much more broadly to cover all higher-priced mortgages, including virtually all closed-end subprime loans secured by a consumer's principal dwelling, and to all mortgage originators.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: These rules also cover a broad range of issues:
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: I'd now like to focus in more detail on some key features of this wide-ranging set of rules and discuss a few of the most important changes that we have made since our proposal this past December because I think they are illustrative of how we approached these issues.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: On one issue, loan affordability, we proposed a rule that would have required a lender to make sure that a borrower could afford the monthly payments before a loan is made.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: This step sounds like common sense, but unfortunately, as some loan originators pushed off more and more of the risk to investors, they made increasingly riskier loans to people who simply could not afford them.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: So we proposed a rule to address that problem, and it spelled out how a lender should assess this ability to repay, building on the earlier interagency guidance on subprime loans.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Lenders would have violated the proposed rule if they engaged in a pattern or practice of making loans without considering consumers' repayment ability.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: During the public notice period, we received a number of comments on the "pattern or practice" element of the proposed rule, and we conducted further outreach to both consumer advocates and industry participants.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Many advocates objected to this heavy burden of proof, calling into question the effectiveness of the intended consumer protection.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Some mortgage lenders, however, suggested that the "pattern or practice" provision did not provide a safe harbor that would ensure compliance and that their procedures for compliance would, by necessity, be equally robust under either version of the rule.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: At the end of the day, we agreed that this provision would have limited the intended effectiveness of the rule and that removing it, along with clarifying other requirements, would not impede the availability of credit to borrowers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Accordingly, the final rule establishes a lender's responsibility to assess a borrower's ability to repay on every loan originated, effectively giving wronged consumers a private right of action without demonstrating that their case was part of a broader pattern.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: In addition, the new rule requires that the lender take into account future, predictable changes in payments in determining repayment ability.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: A lender complies, in part, by assessing repayment ability based on the highest scheduled payment in the first seven years of the loan.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: For example, on a 5-1 ARM with a payment for the first five years based on a discounted interest rate, the lender would use the scheduled payment in the sixth and seventh years, which is based on the fully indexed rate.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Another element of our proposal that received many comments was a rule limiting prepayment penalties.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: On the one hand, numerous commenters argued that prepayment penalties can result in lower interest rates paid by the borrower.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Although there are exceptions I will mention in a moment, a number of studies have found that loans with prepayment penalties carry lower rates or annual percentage rates (APRs) than loans without prepayment penalties having similar credit risk characteristics.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: 2 On the other hand, the rate benefit was called into question by many, who asserted that prepayment penalties may lock borrowers into unaffordable loans, particularly adjustable-rate loans whose payments may change dramatically.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Prepayment penalties were also criticized because of the way they reinforce another potentially abusive practice--yield spread premiums, or YSPs.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Some lenders' rate sheets show that mortgage brokers can earn bigger YSPs, which are essentially commissions, by increasing consumers' interest rates, and the biggest increases are allowed only if a loan contains a prepayment penalty.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: After an exhaustive analysis of the issue and all available data, the Board concluded that the costs and benefits of prepayment penalty provisions on higher-priced mortgages depend, to an important extent, on the structure of the loan.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: It has been common in the subprime market to structure loans to have a short expected life span.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: This aim has been achieved by building in a significant payment increase just a few years after loan consummation.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: With respect to subprime loans designed to have shorter life spans, the injuries from prepayment provisions are potentially the most serious as well as the most difficult for a reasonable consumer to avoid.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Moreover, according to research, the rate reduction for a prepayment penalty provision on such short-lived loans is smaller and, in absolute terms, quite limited.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: For these loans, therefore, the Board concluded that the injuries caused by prepayment penalty provisions outweigh their benefits, and we did ban them for these loans--specifically, loans in which the principal-and-interest payment can change within the first four years.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: With respect to subprime loans structured to have longer expected life spans, however, the Board concluded that the potential for harm from prepayment penalties is lower relative to potential benefits, warranting restrictions but not a ban.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Our analyses indicate that for fixed-rate loans, borrowers can obtain meaningful interest-rate reductions on loans that contain provisions for prepayment penalties, and performance on these loans has typically been superior.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: These factors generally reduce the negative impact of prepayment penalties, so for these loans, we added a restriction limiting the length of the prepayment penalty period to no more than two years.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Another change has to do with how we define the loans that we most want to cover.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Our principal goal was to cover the vast bulk of the subprime market, where most of the problems have been and where consumers may need the most protection.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The challenge is that there is no one accepted definition of what makes a loan "subprime."
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We anticipated, and received, a number of comments about this problem and sought solutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We looked at available sources of data on mortgage rates and concluded that the best source for our purposes is a survey called the Primary Mortgage Market Survey ® , published by Freddie Mac.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The Federal Reserve will publish our own index, called the "average prime offer rate," that will be based on Freddie's survey and other market data, and if we need to adjust the index over time, we can.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We will still cover nearly all of the subprime market plus a sizable fraction of the so-called Alt-A market, as we intended with our initial proposal, but the new approach will do so in a more accurate and consistent way, and therefore better ensure that we protect at-risk consumers without impinging on the prime market.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Protecting borrowers with responsible underwriting standards can also provide a broader benefit of enhancing the integrity and proper functioning of the mortgage market by increasing investor confidence.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Ensuring that ability to repay by underwriting and documenting income, for example, can help to reduce investor uncertainty about the performance of mortgage-backed securities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Effective consumer protection thus can produce a complementary benefit for consumers by helping to revive mortgage funding markets and potentially improving credit availability.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Finally, I'd like to highlight one other change that shows how hard it can sometimes be to craft solutions that work.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: In December, we proposed a rule that we hoped would address some of the problems posed by YSPs.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The heart of the rule involved an agreement that the broker and borrower would sign early on that would spell out the broker's compensation and how they are paid.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: As the public comment period was under way, we began consumer testing to see how this process would actually work.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We engaged a firm that specializes in this testing and conducted a rapid round of tests this spring with individual consumers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The firm developed and tested a form in which the broker would agree to total compensation and make certain disclosures that we thought would help consumers make informed decisions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Throughout the testing, revisions were made to the form in an effort to improve comprehension.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The testing revealed two problems.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The first problem is that many participants believed, after reading the disclosure, that the broker would be obliged to find them the lowest interest rate and best terms available, which is not true.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The second problem was that many participants came to believe that working through a broker would cost them more than working directly with a lender, which is not necessarily true either.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: The firm tried to correct these misunderstandings, but no matter what it did to change the language, the forms continued to confuse consumers more than inform them.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Our consumer testing led us to the conclusion that our approach was not serving its intent--that is, to better inform consumers.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We are continuing to try to find an approach that would be effective, but we did not want to hold up all the other consumer protections while we worked on it.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: As a result, we decided to withdraw the proposed provision on mortgage broker compensation, and we will continue to explore other approaches as part of the ongoing update of our mortgage rules already under way.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Some may have preferred that we stick with our proposal, but creating a rule that informed consumers in theory, but only served to confuse them in practice, would have helped no one.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Conclusion In closing, I would like to underscore the Federal Reserve's commitment to preserving and supporting minority depository institutions.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: I look forward to continuing our constructive dialogue on finding the best and most practical ways to address the challenges that these banks confront.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: I am confident that we will be successful in ensuring that these companies remain strong and continue to provide critical financial support to their communities.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: I also want to stress that finalizing our HOEPA rules does not represent the end of our efforts to improve transparency and consumer protections in mortgage lending.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: We will continue to work diligently to determine how best to address the issue of yield spread premiums.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois

speaker: Kroszner
text: Further, we will collaborate with our partner agencies to enforce these rules and to monitor their impact on the market to ensure that they are effective in achieving their goals of protecting borrowers from abusive practices and preserving the availability of credit from responsible mortgage lenders.
speech_title: Federal Reserve's Initiatives to Support Minority-Owned Institutions and Expand Consumer Protection
speech_venue: Minority Depository Institutions National Conference, Chicago, Illinois
