speaker: Warsh
text: Overview The financial markets did not observe the August anniversary of the onset of turmoil with even a hint of fondness.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 1 Instead, market participants seemed to mark the occasion as a kind of coming-of-age opportunity to act out.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The subsequent despair among market participants, disrepair in credit markets, and disregard for proper market functioning was more pronounced than witnessed in generations.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Significant market dislocations disrupted credit flows to households and firms and impaired economic growth.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: All and all, these conditions demanded--and received--a forceful response from monetary, fiscal, and financial policymakers.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: There are some notable signs of improvement.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Short-term funding spreads are retreating from extremely elevated levels.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Funding maturities are being extended beyond the very near term.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Money market funds and commercial paper markets are showing signs of stabilization.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And credit default swap spreads of banking institutions are narrowing significantly.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Nonetheless, financial markets overall remain strained.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Risk spreads remain quite high and lending standards appear strict.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Indications of economic activity in the United States have turned decidedly negative.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The economy contracted slightly in the third quarter, and the recent data on sales and production suggest that the fourth quarter will be weak.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Still, the depth and duration of this period of weak economic activity remain highly uncertain.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The financial turmoil revealed that the old financial architecture is broken.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But its successor is not yet established.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 2 In my view, the prospects for robust economic growth over the intermediate term are likely to be determined, not principally by the trajectory of housing prices, but by the speed with which a new financial architecture emerges and the form that it takes.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This challenge of creating a new financial architecture is hardly unique to the United States.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The difficult choices made by policymakers and market participants around the globe will have real implications for future growth prospects.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: What do I mean by a new financial architecture?
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Recent travails contributed to a consensus that the financial regulatory framework requires fundamental reform.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But, in my view, the financial architecture is necessarily broader than the government's regulatory and supervisory response.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The new financial architecture, properly understood, must account for the dynamic relationship between private-market actions and public-sector strictures.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The economy's financial architecture is a function of the relationship among financial institutions and market participants that transfer capital and risk between borrowers and savers.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But the architecture is also informed by the mix of prescriptions and postures of the Congress, the Administration, and the financial regulators, including the Federal Reserve.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This circumstance is particularly the case during times of financial turmoil.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In my remarks today, I will first advance a plain assessment of what is afflicting global financial markets.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Many observers judge that weaknesses in housing finance, and the associated boom and bust in the housing sector, are the principal cause of the market turmoil and economic malaise.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In my view, however, recent market developments--in the United States and abroad--strongly indicate that the causes of the turmoil are broader and more fundamental than the problems in the mortgage markets.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Second, I will highlight actions by financial market participants in the transition to a new financial architecture.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Financial institutions are being fundamentally transformed by the events of the last several quarters.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Massive changes in business models, corporate forms, and funding sources are taking place faster than could be imagined even a few months ago.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: There is no going back to the old arrangements, nor should there be.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And a new equilibrium will take shape only when financial institutions seize new opportunities and the changes in the rules of engagement and the relationship with the official sector are more clearly understood.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Third, I will discuss actions of the official sector during this period of turmoil.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Most of these policy actions have been taken in vigorous pursuit of financial stability--that is, to reduce financial stresses, shore up credit intermediation, and thereby support economic activity.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And that makes good sense.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Some material lessening of financial instability is essential so that markets can function properly and the economy can avoid more substantial weakness.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But stability in and of itself should not be the be-all and end-all of policy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Rather, actions fostering financial stability should be temporary, providing a bridge to a new, more effective financial architecture.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And that architecture should aspire to increase, not decrease, potential output through an economic cycle.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Nature of the Financial Market Turmoil Many observers maintain that the boom and bust in the housing market are the root cause of the current turmoil.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: No doubt housing-related losses are negatively affecting household wealth and spending.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Moreover, the weakness in housing markets and uncertainty about its path have caused financial institution balance sheets to deteriorate.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This situation has further accelerated the deleveraging process and tightened credit conditions for businesses and households.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: When liquidity pulled back dramatically in August 2007, housing suffered mightily.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 3 For reasons well documented, including expectations that home prices would invariably increase, housing proved to be a highly vulnerable asset class.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Many homeowners, particularly those that purchased properties during 2005 through 2007, are suffering.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And many banks and other financial firms that extended mortgage credit or purchased mortgage-related assets have written down sharply the value of those assets.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Public and private policy actions have been taken to help cushion the blow to many homeowners and financial firms.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: While housing may well have been the trigger for the onset of the broader financial turmoil, I have long believed it is not the fundamental cause.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 5 Indeed, recent financial market developments strongly indicate that housing, as an asset class, does not stand alone.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Indeed, the problems associated with housing finance reveal broader failings, including inadequate market discipline, excessive reliance on credit ratings, and poor credit and liquidity risk-management practices by many financial firms.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: During the past several months, this domestic housing-centric diagnosis has also been subjected to a natural experiment.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Among U.S. financial institutions, asset quality concerns are no longer confined to the mortgage sector.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: At the same time, non-U.S. financial institutions--including some with relatively modest exposures to the United States or their own domestic housing markets--appear to be suffering substantial losses.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Equity prices of European banks declined more on average during 2008 year-to-date than their U.S. counterparts.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Moreover, economic weakness among our advanced foreign trading partners is increasingly evident, even among economies with more modest exposures to the housing sector.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: If the challenges to the economy were predominantly about the value of the housing stock, my focus today would be far narrower than the establishment of a new financial architecture.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: So, what diagnosis, beyond housing weakness, is consistent with the unprecedented levels of volatility and dramatic financial market and economic distress?
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: I would advance the following: We are witnessing a fundamental reassessment of the value of virtually every asset everywhere in the world.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Short-term funding markets have become suspect.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Roll-overs of existing maturities reveal systematic underpricing of once seemingly benign risks--credit, liquidity, counterparty, and even sovereign risks--which demand reassessment and recalibration.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Indeed, wide-ranging assessments of these risks are being crudely incorporated into the pricing of virtually all assets.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In some cases, at present, the risks do not appear to be reliably quantifiable, and trading has become impaired.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Until these assessments are more cleanly refined and more broadly understood, we are likely to observe elevated levels of volatility and unwillingness by many investors to participate in certain asset markets virtually at any price.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This phenomenon is proving quite detrimental to global economic growth.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In my view, the speed and success of a new financial architecture is likely to be more consequential to economic growth than the design and implementation of well-intended housing policies alone.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The establishment of a new financial architecture, thus, is the essential policy response to the greatest economic challenge of our time.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Financial Institution Response in Pursuit of Survival and Success In a speech about seven months ago, I noted that the transformation of financial institutions would be among the key variables that would affect the path of the real economy, but "the changing paradigm of financial intermediation" is happening even more abruptly.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 6 The largest investment banks chose a different fate, or had one chosen for them.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Many of the largest nonbank financial companies are no doubt reviewing their regulatory status.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Large numbers of hedge funds, recently perceived as central to a well-diversified asset allocation program, are struggling for survival.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Their investors are being rudely reminded that alpha-returns cannot, by definition, be universally achieved.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Large money center banks are casting a keen eye on their sources and uses of funding.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And traditional community-based banks are adapting to a dramatically different competitive dynamic with respect to deposits and lending opportunities alike.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The business of banking--and credit intermediation, more broadly--is fundamentally changing.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Wholesale funding models are severely stressed.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Heavy reliance on interbank funding and short-term indebtedness is proving highly detrimental to a financial institutions' health and society's welfare.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Some of the highest-rated financial products, ironically, are suffering the greatest diminutions in value.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Selling volatility and insuring tail risks are far riskier propositions than many imagined.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: These products and practices are proving to be a significant source of large, uncapped losses threatening to impair once-hearty franchises.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: We are witnessing perhaps the fastest, most significant structural shift in the history of the financial services sector.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The direct share of value added in the finance and insurance sector approximated 8 percent of U.S. gross domestic produce (GDP) in recent years.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This is about 3 percentage points higher than the contribution of financial services to GDP only a generation ago.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Similarly, profits of the Standard & Poor's 500 attributable to the finance sector peaked at more than 21 percent during this cycle, 5-1/2 percentage points greater than a decade ago.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: As the financial sector continues to delever and many financial products disappear altogether, the sector's shares of GDP and profits will shrink further.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This reduction could involve many firms shrinking largely in tandem or, more likely, the orderly unwinding or sale of inefficient or unwise firms.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 7 The markets are fearful, in part I suspect, because of the swiftness of the reallocation of resources in the financial sector.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Official Sector Response in Pursuit of Financial Stability The turmoil of the past several quarters coincides with further erosion of confidence in what financial institutions and other market participants knew--or thought they knew--about the environment in which they were operating.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: It is no surprise, then, that those bearing the brunt of the turmoil are pining for calmer times, a period of less volatility, when market prices again comport with historical regressions and newfangled financial models.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: To wit, a return to financial stability.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Government officials, in the U.S. and abroad, are not unsympathetic to this aspiration for calmer times.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 8 But policymakers are prudent to balance the near-term imperative to take actions to achieve financial stability with the objective--just over the horizon--of facilitating the development of a new financial architecture in which market participants re-engage, provide credit to the real economy, and yes, succeed or fail.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Fed has a long and proud tradition, not solely as the monetary authority, but also as a regulator, supervisor, and lender of last resort to help foster financial stability.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 9 The Fed is in the financial stability business.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But it's not our only business.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Federal Reserve's financial stability responsibilities are not, in my view, an independent goal of policy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: They are best understood through the lens of our broader objectives for the economy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The conduct of monetary policy, banking supervision and regulation, and the provision of liquidity are regular Federal Reserve activities that contribute to financial stability, and in so doing, help achieve improved macroeconomic performance.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: During this period of turmoil, the Fed has increasingly been called upon to be a steadying influence.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: When appropriate, and after due consideration, the Fed has chosen to employ its balance sheet, authority, and credibility to lessen the harm to the real economy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: That is our role and responsibility.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But we should resist the temptation to play a larger role than statutorily mandated or economically prudent.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Good-faith pleas for relief in the name of financial stability will continue for some time, and the Fed should carefully consider the facts and circumstances.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: That period of consideration may require us, however, to be cognizant of the perils of popularity and decline to take action, including when it may be more properly considered or better addressed by the fiscal authorities.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: So it is, financial stability has become the watchword of the global economy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But its frequency in our lexicon should not be confused with clarity as to its meaning or the timing of its achievement.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Nor should it be construed as the sole beacon of policy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: It is perhaps easier to define by its absence.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 10 Financial instability is a situation in which stresses on markets and institutions are sufficiently severe that the intermediation between borrowers and savers is threatened, with the prospect of significant risks to the broader economy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Financial stability, moreover, should not be equated with an absence of volatility.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: If some unexpected news arrives, markets adjust, often sharply.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Generally, these adjustments are not cases of financial instability.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: A healthy and well-functioning financial system will reward well-managed risk-taking and punish imprudence, sometimes harshly.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Such outcomes are not pretty and can be marked by large and pervasive losses, but most do not necessitate extraordinary policy interventions.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Nonetheless, circumstances of pronounced financial instability, while rare, do arise.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In the most recent episode, we policymakers deemed it necessary to take significant actions to mitigate the risks to the real economy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Financial firms became highly protective of their balance sheets and sought to disengage en masse from the provision of credit.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Fed responded, introducing lending facilities designed to support liquidity in overnight and short-term funding markets.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: With the approval of the Congress, Treasury also took significant action, making large capital injections directly into banks to help jump-start the credit intermediation process.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This action was supplemented by various forms of government guarantees.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But bold official policy responses, even when successful in combating financial instability, may not be enough to support the resumption of trend economic growth over the medium term.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Why is government action aimed at financial stability not sufficient to usher in a new era of prosperity?
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Because the broader financial architecture remains in substantial flux, as is sometimes unavoidable.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Confidence in markets and institutions cannot be demanded or forced by edict.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Confidence in a new architecture cannot be jury-rigged, even by well-designed government actions.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Nor can confidence be rushed.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Comprehensive policy prescriptions to address financial instability are now being delivered to the ailing patient.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But a dose of patience itself may be equally important to help the recuperative process.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Time is required for the medicines to be administered and their efficacy to be judged.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: New prescriptions, however well intentioned, can prove unsettling to a patient who is searching to find his footing.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Of course, policy must respond to serious situations as they arise; and, during the past 15 months, these developments have been difficult to anticipate with precision.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But, if the framework for policy decisions is not viewed as clear, consistent, and predictable by market participants, the resulting actions run the risk of contributing to, rather than reducing, market volatility--at the most inauspicious of times.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Finally, actions intended to help achieve financial stability should not be allowed to interfere with the establishment of a sturdy, new financial architecture.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Concluding Remarks I am reminded of a certain Omaha-based investor who says that his investment style is to be greedy when other investors are fearful, and be fearful when others are greedy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 11 I would modify the advice somewhat to make it applicable to policymakers: We should be steady when financial market participants are fearful, and fearful when markets appear steady.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This call for steadiness is not some nostrum, implying that the government should be passive during times of significant economic turmoil.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But comprehensive policy prescriptions are most effective when they establish new rules of engagement that are clear in intent, consistent in application, and reasonably predictable in effect.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This policy formulation should allow financial firms to regain their footing and market participants, more broadly, to take new, constructive actions to facilitate the availability of credit.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Perhaps in this way, policymakers and market participants alike can best contribute to the development of a reformed and robust financial architecture.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: I see more promise than peril over the horizon.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The speed of these changes in the financial architecture understandably brings fear to some market participants, but it may equally sow the seeds of recovery.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Policymakers are keenly observing the pulse of private financial institutions and other market participants to gauge their ability to take up the cause of reform and renewal.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: If financial institutions readily and steadily approach new ways of intermediating credit, the real economy might recover sooner and with more vigor than expected.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: If not, if private market participants prove unable or unwilling to establish new business models, then the effects of the current financial market turmoil may be a significant drag on economic growth long after stability is ostensibly achieved.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Getting the architecture right is essential to address the central challenge facing our economy.
speech_title: The Promise and Peril of the New Financial Architecture
speech_venue: At the Money Marketeers of New York University, New York, New York
