speaker: Warsh
text: In a seminal essay delivered about 16 years ago, Senator Daniel Patrick Moynihan offered a striking view of the degradation of standards in society.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 1 He observed that deviancy--measured as increases in crime, broken homes, and mental illness--reached levels unimagined by earlier generations.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: As a means of coping with the onslaught, society often sought to define the problem away.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The definition of customary behavior was expanded.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Actions once considered deviant from acceptable standards became, almost immaculately, within bounds.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 2 Society moves on, as it were.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Well-meaning efforts are periodically made to treat its failings.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But if these efforts prove less than successful, citizens and policymakers alike tend to grow increasingly accustomed to the unfortunate statistics.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Every bit the reformer throughout his decades of public service, Moynihan seemed reluctantly resigned to society's construct: "In this sense, the agencies of control often seem to define their job as that of keeping deviance within bounds rather than that of obliterating it altogether."
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 3 Given the financial crisis, deep contraction in the real economy, and extraordinary fiscal and monetary responses, I cannot help but wonder what constitutes deviance in economic terms in 2009 and beyond.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: What level of real economic output and unemployment is expected and, more important, accepted?
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And what level of volatility constitutes the "new normal"?
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 4 As I will discuss, we must be wary of macroeconomic policies that--in the name of stability-- may have the effect of lowering trend growth and employment rates.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In Moynihan's framework, will we in the official sector be accepting of periods of significant financial and economic distress, however infrequent?
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: That is, will deviancy be defined down with the understanding that a rare crisis is the price for dynamic, robust economic growth?
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Or will the official sector say, "Never again--not on our watch," and become less tolerant of deviations in economic and financial conditions?
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Under the mantle of reforming capitalism, will policymakers instead define deviancy up, and seek to guarantee stability in our economic affairs?
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: I suspect that, for a time, policymakers will be more attracted to this latter path.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Stability is a fine goal, but it is not a final one.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Long after panic conditions have ended, stability threatens to displace economic growth as the primary macroeconomic policy objective.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But we must recognize that the singular pursuit of stability, however well intentioned, may end up making our economy less productive, less adaptive, and less self-correcting--and in so doing, less able to deliver on its alluring promise.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This fate, however, does not have to be ours.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The U.S. economy is capable, in my judgment, of delivering more.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Growth Experiment 5 This most recent boom and bust is not, as they say, our country's first rodeo, but it may turn out to be the most consequential since World War II.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And, here, I am not just talking about the near-term peak-to-trough changes in growth and employment levels, which are likely to prove significant.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Policymakers are revealing new policy preferences and prescriptions--fiscal policy, trade policy, regulatory policy, and monetary policy, chiefly among them.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Long after the official recession ends, the choices being made may significantly alter the contour of the U.S. economy.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The harder question that remains is whether these changes will prove beneficial.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: From the mid-1980s through 2007, U.S. real gross domestic product (GDP) growth averaged more than 3 percent per year, and was less volatile than in previous decades.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The average unemployment rate was less than 5-3/4 percent, a full percentage point less than in the previous 15 years.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Most notable was the realized acceleration in labor productivity in the mid-1990s.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The bipartisan, pro-growth policies that predominated during this period contributed meaningfully to these gains.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Tax and spending decisions generally sought to expand the economic pie.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Trade policies were aimed at opening new markets to U.S. products and services, and removing barriers domestically.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Regulatory policies permitted failure, and relied in equal parts on capital requirements, regulatory standards, and, no less important, market discipline.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: As a result, businesses were well positioned to adopt new efficiency-enhancing technologies and processes to excel in the pro-growth environment.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: These policies helped drive significant productivity gains, and remarkable U.S. and global prosperity.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 6 I do not mean to suggest that the period that preceded the crisis was a golden age.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Even during this seemingly enviable, secular period of prosperity, the U.S. recessions of 1990-91 and 2001 remind us that periodic, cyclical weakness occurs.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The labor markets deteriorated during these downturns, and at great costs to many families and communities.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But these periodic deviations were accepted, in some sense, by the body politic.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: There were lessons to be learned, reforms to be implemented, and public and private practices to be improved upon.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But the broad outlines of the growth experiment forged on, and were judged by most to be largely a success.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Hence, the relative stability that earned the Great Moderation its enduring moniker is not, in my view, the greatest economic accomplishment of the past few decades.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The acclaim should be assigned to the resulting economic boom that massively increased economic output and living standards.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Maximum sustainable growth, not stability per se, was the predominant policy goal.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Strong growth, of course, was made possible, in part, by the low volatility that marked the period.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 7 Firms choose to invest more, for example, in less volatile economic conditions.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But, pro-growth policies were the coin of the realm.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But, as I remarked to another group of international financiers more than two years ago: "The Great Moderationâ¦is neither a law of physics nor a guarantee of future outcomes.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: It is only a description--an ex post explanation of relative prosperity.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: If policymakers and market participants presume it to be an entitlement, it will almost surely lose favor."
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 8 Well, warnings notwithstanding, it was treated like an entitlement by far too many in the private and public sector, and as a result, lost considerable favor.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Panic of 2008 Has the experience of the last 20 months caused the findings of the vaunted growth experiment to be fundamentally revised?
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: During this recent period of turmoil, the imponderable, or what was previously thought to be virtually impossible, happened with great speed and force and frequency.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 9 Asset prices plummeted, and market volatility reached its highest level in decades.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Financial market functioning was deeply impaired across most asset classes and geographies.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: As a result, the U.S. economy endured a sudden stop.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In the final quarter of last year and the first quarter of this year, private employment registered the largest two-quarter percent decline since the mid-1970s, and real GDP saw the most dramatic decline in a half-century.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: These data are clearly indicative of significant deviance, and justifiably raise questions about the success of the growth experiment.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Policymakers are rightly disposed to react, respond, and revisit the presumed record of accomplishment.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In revising the historical record, however, we should not too hastily discount the preceding period of prosperity.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: We must avoid a classic case of what behavioral economists term "availability bias," when decisions made are influenced disproportionately by more recent events.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Ultimately, I will leave it to economic historians to assess whether the Panic of 2008 was more anomalous than the period of prosperity that preceded it.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: I believe that the categorization of recent events as deviant, ultimately, will depend on what happens next.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: That is, if policy changes cause future economic performance to suffer, then the boom of the last generation may, regrettably, turn out to be more exceptional than the bust .
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Stability Experiment That new policies are being implemented during a period of economic turmoil is no coincidence.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: These new preferences reveal much about the type of economy to which policymakers aspire.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And to be clear, the stability experiment appears well intended.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: It aspires to manage the economy with greater care and more expansive and effective regulation, as well as a larger and more persistent role for government action, and an increase in home bias in global commerce.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Advocates of the stability experiment--each guided by their own compass--seem all too inclined to announce that the growth experiment has ended, and to conclude that the results are deeply disappointing.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: They seem to prefer to define deviancy up, wishing to assure an uncertain citizenry.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: If government policies are corrected, and private practices are made more prescriptive, they argue, the ship of state can ensure that the real economy avoids rough seas altogether.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The political economy confirms the policy response: Policymakers may pay greater attention to insuring against rare bad events--to which they could be held to account--than to allowing scores of great things to flourish.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: As I mentioned at the outset, stability, in the sense of lower macroeconomic volatility, is a fine objective, but it is not a final one.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The conduct of monetary policy, for example, aims to achieve price stability throughout the economic cycle.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But central bankers do so because we believe it is the precursor to strong and sustainable growth.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: If other policies--notably, those for fiscal, regulatory, and trade--treat stability as the ultimate objective, then we might find ourselves with lower growth and diminished economic potential.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Reform efforts are sorely needed, and practices demand marked improvement.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But policymakers are wise to resist the hubris that most recently afflicted actors in the financial sector.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: I describe this mix of new pro-stability policies as an experiment for good reason.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: It might deliver on its promise of lower volatility, lower unemployment, and higher growth over the course of a generation.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The costs of the stability experiment might turn out to be large.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Necessarily and hastily crafted when the financial crisis began, the stability experiment is likely to survive far longer than the panic that preceded it.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: It is surging in popularity and is likely to grow in application, particularly if, as I suspect, the economic picture disappoints.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Incipient Recovery Since mid-March of this year, financial conditions have continued to improve.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Panic conditions are showing signs of retreat.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Asset prices are rebounding, searching for a new equilibrium from their panic-induced depths--both in the United States and across the vast majority of our trading partners.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And this improvement in markets coincided with the arrival of the proverbial green shoots of spring.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This gloss of recovery is appealing, of course, and not only to central bankers.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: I, like you, am rooting for the positive trend to continue.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But, in my estimation, the rather indiscriminate bounce off the bottom--across virtually all assets and geographies--may be more indicative of a one-time reset, which may or may not be complete.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: I would be more comfortable going forward if we observe more dispersion in the valuations of particular assets and greater differentiation across asset classes and geographies.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The panic's hasty retreat should not be confused with robust recovery.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: For economic performance will turn ultimately on the force of private final demand; and for now, it remains weak.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Real consumer spending rose only modestly in the first quarter of this year, after dropping sharply in the second half of last year.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Businesses reduced real spending at an annual rate of more than 35 percent and continued to cut their workforces.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Real exports fell at an annual rate of close to 30 percent.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The trauma experienced by businesses and consumers coming out of the panic should not be underestimated.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Notwithstanding recent encouraging signs that the contraction is abating, I would expect business capital expenditures and consumer spending to continue to disappoint for the next several quarters.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Even if, as I expect, the United States emerges from this recession sooner than our advanced foreign trading partners, I am still very cautious about predicting a sustained run-up in net exports so soon after the virtual collapse of global trade.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Exceptional fiscal expenditures, by their own terms, are intended to replace shortfalls in aggregate demand.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And recent extraordinary monetary policy actions are intended to lower risk-free rates and grow balance sheet capacity to help offset the pullback by private financial intermediaries.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But financial markets may extract penalty pricing if fiscal authorities are unable to demonstrate a credible return to sustainable budgets.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And they are unlikely to look kindly on monetary authorities unless they decidedly and unambiguously chart their own independent paths.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The Federal Reserve should not--and will not--compromise another kind of stability--price stability--to help achieve other government policy objectives.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: On balance, I would not be surprised if these countervailing forces--unprecedented public support and underwhelming private demand--fight to a draw by the fourth quarter.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But the scale of stimulus and the recent blow to the real economy are both lacking precedent, so predicting the victor is tough business.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Of course, the extraordinary monetary and fiscal support may prove more efficacious in the near term than I expect, leading to a continued easing in credit conditions, a slowdown in the rate of deleveraging, improved inventory levels, and better quarterly economic statistics.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Even so, the benefits of stimulus are likely to wane.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: More important, unemployment rates, in my judgment, are likely to remain higher and linger longer than in recent recessions.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The "jobless recovery" may prove to be a familiar and vexing refrain.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: As a wise Stanford mentor of mine coined many years ago, "The economist's lag is a politician's nightmare."
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 10 Medium-Term Prospects The rebalancing of U.S. GDP and global demand is likely to require some patience.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: During the transition, there may well be political impetus for still more-aggressive macroeconomic policies.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In evaluating new measures, however, policymakers' predominant interest should be ensuring the credibility of their fiscal and monetary frameworks.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: For, if macroeconomic policies were to become unanchored, or misunderstood by markets, continued government aggressiveness could prove counterproductive.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The global economy runs the risk of being mired in a period of slower growth for several years to come.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Some portion of the subpar economic performance may be owed to the normal capital and labor reallocations that take place during recoveries.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And given the serious misallocations that marked the onset of this recession, there is good reason to believe that the period of reallocation will be deeper and last longer.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: A reduction in the size of the finance and housing industries, for example, is well under way.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Efforts to forestall those changes, in my judgment, are unlikely to succeed as promisingly as advertised.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But perhaps a larger risk is that changes in public policies may, in the pursuit of stability, hold down the growth of the U.S. economy over this period.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Simple textbook models tell us that a nation's output is the product of the number of hours worked and the output produced per hour.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In thinking about the medium-term prospects for the economy, I find it useful to consider these two factors separately.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Output per hour, or productivity, is the secret sauce to U.S. economic growth and to rising living standards, but I fear that the recipe may have lost some key ingredients.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Growth in labor productivity arises when a firm's workers use more and better physical capital, or when firms become more efficient at converting inputs into output.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Innovation plays a key role, both because it directly boosts efficiency and because firms' decisions to invest in physical capital tend to depend on the underlying pace of innovation.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: In addition, in today's economy, the productivity of many firms relies heavily on intangible, or intellectual, capital; although hard to measure, intangible capital appears to also be tied to innovation.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: To be concrete, from 1995 through 2007, U.S. labor productivity growth in the nonfarm business sector averaged about 2-1/2 percent per year, a marked improvement from the 1-3/4 percent pace that marked the prior quarter century.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: This period of rapid growth in labor productivity was driven by large capital investments, significant improvements in management processes, and remarkable advances in technology.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Looking ahead, if policy is less encouraging of capital accumulation, or returns to innovations are constrained by policy, we may find a material reduction in the growth rate of productivity and living standards.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The level of support that the financial system is capable of providing also remains highly uncertain.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Private financial institutions are now understandably slow to create new products that connect savers and investors.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Although it is undesirable to revert to the excessive risk-taking that preceded the crisis, current financial practices seem suboptimal in promoting economic growth.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Furthermore, repeated interventions by the public sector run the risk of causing systemically significant institutions to operate more like public utilities than efficient allocators of capital and proper arbiters of liquidity.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Productivity may also suffer at the hand of policies that discourage trade.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Trade enhances productivity by promoting efficient specialization, permitting economies of scale, and increasing the potential returns to innovation.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: 11 However, the bipartisan consensus favoring free trade appears broken, with each political party internally divided on the question.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Given the contention, however imprecise, that Anglo-American-style capitalism caused the turmoil, there may be a shortage of credible and persuasive voices to fight the growing global tide of economic isolation.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: As for hours worked, the other key determinant of output, the risks seem unmistakable.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: We have grown accustomed to falling natural rates of unemployment during the last two decades.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Even when unemployment spiked during recent recessions, the prevailing rate found its way to still lower levels.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: According to most economists, the non-accelerating inflation rate of unemployment (NAIRU) was in the neighborhood of 5 percent prior to the financial crisis.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Looking ahead, I could well imagine that the natural rate of unemployment trends higher.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Historically, small businesses have tended to be the largest drivers of new job creation.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: But how they will respond if macroeconomic policies favor stability over growth is difficult to predict.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The answer may ultimately depend on their access to growth capital and liquidity given the changing mix of public policies and private practices.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: More generally, I believe that the dynamism of the U.S. economy contributed critically to pre-crisis levels of employment.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: The remarkably low level of the NAIRU was made possible in part by the extraordinary churn in jobs seen in the U.S. economy.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: For example, over the 12 months preceding the start of the recession in December 2007, although 62 million people lost their jobs, 63 million jobs were created.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Policies aimed at limiting the range of economic outcomes do not, in my view, keep unemployment rates low.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: These policies make it more costly for firms to adjust the size of their workforces, thereby making employers more reluctant to hire.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Gauging trend growth in output and employment is essential to the proper conduct of monetary policy.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Broad changes in macroeconomic policies may make it more difficult for central bankers to make such calculations.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: To the extent changed policies reduce potential growth, or raise the natural rate of unemployment beyond recent estimates, it is more difficult to make good and timely policy.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: We must keep a keen eye on these risks as conditions evolve.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Ironically, the longer that output and employment disappoint, the more attractive the gloss of stability may become.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: As a result, we should evaluate the benefits and costs of the stability experiment with a keen eye to guard against downside risks for the real economy.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Longer-Term Prospects I have not lost confidence in the inherent innovation, creativity, and dynamism in the U.S. economy.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: Nor have I lost confidence in the inherent good sense of our citizens.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: If the stability experiment fails to deliver on its promise of higher employment and better economic performance, then policymakers ultimately will change their prescriptions yet again.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speaker: Warsh
text: And so, in the long term, after the final results of the U.S. experiments with growth and stability are finally tabulated, the broader U.S. experiment in democratic capitalism will endure--and our economy will emerge stronger than ever.
speech_title: Defining Deviancy
speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York

speech_venue: At the Institute of International Bankers Annual Meeting, New York, New York
